title.zh: 卷14 本紀十四 高宗本紀五
title.raw: 卷14 本紀十四 高宗本紀五

sentences.zh: 四十一年春正月癸酉朔，富德克打噶咱普德爾窩、馬爾邦等碉卡。

translations.literal: Forty-first year, spring, first month, new moon on day guiyou: Fu De captured blockhouses and forts at Dagazhapuderwo, Ma'erbang, and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Qianlong 41, on the first-month new moon, Fu De took Dagazhapuderwo, Ma'erbang, and other Jinchuan forts.

sentences.zh: 明亮等克獨松等碉卡。

translations.literal: Ming Liang and others captured blockhouses and forts at Dusong and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: Ming Liang seized Dusong and other blockhouse forts.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，定郡王綿德以交結禮部司員削爵，命綿恩承襲。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Prince Ding Mian De was stripped of his title for collusion with a Ministry of Rites clerk; Mian En was ordered to succeed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Prince Ding Mian De lost his rank for Rites collusion and Mian En inherited.

sentences.zh: 阿桂克喇烏喇等碉卡及舍齊等寺。

translations.literal: Agui captured blockhouses and forts at Lawula and elsewhere, and monasteries at Sheqi and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: Agui took Lawula forts and Sheqi monasteries.

sentences.zh: 己卯，阿桂率諸軍進圍噶喇依，索諾木之母及其姑姊妹出降。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Agui led the armies in advancing to besiege Galayi; Sonom's mother and his paternal aunts and sisters came out to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Agui besieged Galayi and Sonom's mother and aunts surrendered.

sentences.zh: 命封阿桂一等誠謀英勇公，予四團龍補服、金黃帶。

translations.literal: He was ordered enfeoffed as a first-class Duke of Sincere Planning and Brave Merit, granted four-claw dragon insignia and a golden yellow belt.
translations.idiomatic: Agui was made a first-class duke with four-claw dragon dress and a golden yellow belt.

sentences.zh: 加賞果毅繼勇公豐升額一等子。

translations.literal: Feng Sheng'e, Duke Guoyi Jiyong, was additionally granted the rank of first-class viscount.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Sheng'e, Duke Guoyi Jiyong, was raised to a first-class viscount.

sentences.zh: 封明亮一等襄勇伯，海蘭察一等超勇侯，額森特一等男，和隆武三等果勇侯，福康安、普爾普三等男。

translations.literal: Ming Liang was enfeoffed as a first-class Baron Xiangyong; Hai Lancha as a first-class Marquis Chaoyong; Esente as a first-class baron; Helongwu as a third-class Marquis Guoyong; Fukang'an and Pu'erpu as third-class barons.
translations.idiomatic: Ming Liang became Baron Xiangyong; Hai Lancha, Marquis Chaoyong; Esente, baron; Helongwu, Marquis Guoyong; Fukang'an and Pu'erpu, barons.

sentences.zh: 加賞奎林一等男。

translations.literal: Kuilin was additionally granted the rank of first-class baron.
translations.idiomatic: Kuilin was raised to a first-class baron.

sentences.zh: 豐升額、明亮、海蘭察、奎林、和隆武仍各予雙眼花翎，賞于敏中一等輕車都尉，均世襲。

translations.literal: Feng Sheng'e, Ming Liang, Hai Lancha, Kuilin, and Helongwu were each again granted double-eyed peacock feathers; Yu Minzhong was granted a first-class Commandant of Light Chariots—all hereditary.
translations.idiomatic: The five commanders kept double peacock feathers; Yu Minzhong received a hereditary chariot commandancy.

sentences.zh: 阿桂請安插降眾於綽斯甲布十二土司地方，從之。

translations.literal: Agui requested that surrendered people be resettled in the territories of the twelve Chosiakabu tusi; the request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Agui's plan to resettle surrenderers among twelve Chosiakabu tusi was approved.

sentences.zh: 壬午，賞阿桂紫韁。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Agui was rewarded with purple reins.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Agui received purple reins.

sentences.zh: 甲申，調明善為科布多參贊大臣。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Ming Shan was transferred to be Kobdo expedition minister.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Ming Shan became Kobdo expedition minister.

sentences.zh: 以法福里為烏里雅蘇台參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Fa Fuli was made Uliasutai expedition minister.
translations.idiomatic: Fa Fuli took Uliasutai as expedition minister.

sentences.zh: 己丑，吏部尚書、協辦大學士官保以病乞休，允之。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Minister of Personnel and Associate Grand Secretary Guan Bao, because of illness, requested retirement; permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Guan Bao, personnel minister and associate grand secretary, retired on illness.

sentences.zh: 以阿桂為吏部尚書、協辦大學士。

translations.literal: Agui was made Minister of Personnel and Associate Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Agui became personnel minister and associate grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 調豐升額為戶部尚書，福隆安為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Feng Sheng'e was transferred to be Minister of Revenue; Fu Long'an to Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Sheng'e took revenue; Fu Long'an, war.

sentences.zh: 以綽克托為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Choertu was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Choertu became works minister.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，嘉謨遷倉場侍郎。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Jiamo was transferred to be granary commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Jiamo became granary commissioner.

sentences.zh: 命阿思哈署漕運總督，永貴署吏部尚書，英廉署戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Asiha was ordered to act as grain-transport governor-general; Yonggui to act as Minister of Personnel; Yinglian to act as Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Asiha acted as grain-transport governor-general; Yonggui, personnel; Yinglian, revenue.

sentences.zh: 二月己酉，授文綬四川總督，調富勒渾為湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiyou: Wenshou was appointed Sichuan governor-general; Fulehun was transferred to be Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, jiyou, Wenshou took Sichuan and Fulehun took Huguang.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，命嗣後社稷壇祭時，或值風雨，於殿內致祭。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, an order stated that henceforth when the earth-altar sacrifice fell on days of wind or rain, the rite was to be performed inside the hall.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, earth-altar rites in bad weather were ordered moved indoors.

sentences.zh: 蠲江蘇上元等三十九州縣、鎮江等五衛四十年旱災額賦。

translations.literal: Quota taxes were remitted for forty years of drought disaster in thirty-nine Jiangsu prefectures and counties including Shangyuan and in five guards including Zhenjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-nine Jiangsu counties and five guards lost forty years of drought taxes.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，上謁東陵。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, the Emperor paid rites at the Eastern Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Hongli worshipped at the Eastern Tombs.

sentences.zh: 以祇謁兩陵，並巡幸山東，免經過州縣本年額賦十分之三。

translations.literal: Because he was paying rites at both tombs and making a progress tour of Shandong, one-third of this year's quota taxes were remitted for prefectures and counties along the route.
translations.idiomatic: One-third of the year's tax was remitted along the Shandong progress route.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，上謁昭西陵、孝陵、孝東陵、景陵，詣孝賢皇后陵奠酒。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the Emperor paid rites at the Western Zhao Tombs, Xiaoling, Xiao East Tombs, and Jing Tomb, and offered wine at Empress Xiaoxian's tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Hongli worshipped at the Western Zhao, Xiaoling, Xiao East, and Jing tombs and at Empress Xiaoxian's tomb.

sentences.zh: 阿桂等奏索諾木等出降，檻送京師，兩金川平。

translations.literal: Agui and others memorialized that Sonom and others had come out to surrender and were caged and sent to the capital; both Jinchuan were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Agui reported Sonom's surrender in a cage cart and the pacification of both Jinchuan.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，命永貴回禮部尚書，仍兼署吏部事。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Yonggui was ordered to return as Minister of Rites while still acting in Personnel affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Yonggui resumed rites while still acting in personnel.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，命圖平定金川前後五十功臣像於紫光閣。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, an order was issued to paint the likenesses of fifty meritorious officials before and after the pacification of the Two Jinchuan in the Hall of Purple Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, fifty Jinchuan victors were ordered painted at the Purple Splendor Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 命新設將軍駐雅州，四川提督桂林駐金川。

translations.literal: An order was issued to establish a new general stationed at Ya'an and to station Sichuan regional commander Guilin at Jinchuan.
translations.idiomatic: A new general was posted to Ya'an and Guilin to Jinchuan.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Hongli returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 戊午，上謁泰陵。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, the Emperor paid rites at Tailing.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Hongli worshipped at Tailing.

sentences.zh: 命袁守侗赴四川，會同阿桂查辦參贊大臣富德。

translations.literal: Yuan Shoudong was ordered to go to Sichuan to join Agui in investigating and handling the case of expedition minister Fu De.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Shoudong was sent to Sichuan to try Fu De with Agui.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，上謁泰陵。

translations.literal: On day renxu, the Emperor paid rites at Tailing.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Hongli worshipped at Tailing again.

sentences.zh: 設雲南騰越鎮總兵官。

translations.literal: The post of Yunnan Tengyue garrison commander was established.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan gained a Tengyue garrison commander.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，上奉皇太后巡幸山東。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, made a progress tour of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Hongli and the Empress Dowager toured Shandong.

sentences.zh: 己巳，免順天直隸通州等二十八州縣未完地糧倉穀。

translations.literal: On day jisi, unfinished land-tax grain and granary grain were remitted for twenty-eight prefectures and counties including Tongzhou in Shuntian-Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, twenty-eight Zhili counties including Tongzhou were forgiven unfinished grain taxes.

sentences.zh: 庚午，停湖北勘丈湖地。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, the Hubei survey of lake lands was halted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Hubei lake-land surveying was stopped.

sentences.zh: 免直隸霸州等二十一州縣未完地糧倉穀。

translations.literal: Unfinished land-tax grain and granary grain were remitted for twenty-one prefectures and counties including Bazhou in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-one Zhili counties including Bazhou lost unfinished grain taxes.

sentences.zh: 辛未，減直隸軍流以下人犯罪。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, punishments were reduced for military exiles and below in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Zhili reduced sentences for military exiles and below.

sentences.zh: 三月丁丑，免山東泰安、曲阜二縣本年額賦。

translations.literal: Third month, day dingchou: quota taxes for this year were remitted for Tai'an and Qufu in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, dingchou, Tai'an and Qufu were tax-exempt for the year.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，免山東鄒平等三十九州縣衛各項民欠額賦。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, all categories of civilian tax arrears were remitted for thirty-nine Shandong prefectures, counties, and guards including Zouping.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, thirty-nine Shandong districts lost civilian tax arrears.

sentences.zh: 己卯，增設成都將軍，以明亮為之。

translations.literal: On day jimao, the post of Chengdu general was added, with Ming Liang appointed to it.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Ming Liang became the new Chengdu general.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，減山東軍流以下人犯罪。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, punishments were reduced for military exiles and below in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Shandong reduced sentences for military exiles and below.

sentences.zh: 壬午，免山東德州等十一州縣緩徵漕米漕項。

translations.literal: On day renwu, deferred grain-transport rice and transport levies were remitted for eleven Shandong prefectures and counties including Dezhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, eleven Shandong districts lost deferred transport grain levies.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以薩載為江南河道總督，楊魁為江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, Sa Zai was made Jiangnan canal governor-general; Yang Kui was made Jiangsu governor.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Sa Zai took the Jiangnan canal and Yang Kui, Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 甲申，勒爾謹陛見，命畢沅署陝甘總督。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Le'erjin had an audience; Bi Yuan was ordered to act as Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Le'erjin had audience and Bi Yuan acted as Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，上駐蹕泰安，謁岱廟。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, the Emperor halted at Tai'an and paid rites at the Dai Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Hongli halted at Tai'an and worshipped at the Dai Temple.

sentences.zh: 命還督撫貢物，仍嚴飭之。

translations.literal: An order was issued to return governors' tribute gifts, while still issuing strict admonitions.
translations.idiomatic: Governors' tribute gifts were returned under renewed strict warnings.

sentences.zh: 設金川勒烏圍總兵。

translations.literal: The post of Jinchuan Lewei garrison commander was established.
translations.idiomatic: Jinchuan gained a Lewei garrison commander.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，上登泰山。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, the Emperor ascended Mount Tai.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Hongli climbed Mount Tai.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，戶部尚書王際華卒，以袁守侗代之。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Minister of Revenue Wang Jihua died; Yuan Shoudong was transferred to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Wang Jihua died and Yuan Shoudong took revenue.

sentences.zh: 免四川通省上年額賦及本年夷賦有差。

translations.literal: Quota taxes for the previous year and this year's yi levies were remitted for all of Sichuan province, with differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: All Sichuan lost last year's quota tax and this year's yi levies, by degree.

sentences.zh: 蠲河南武陟縣四十年水災額賦。

translations.literal: Quota taxes were remitted for forty years of flood disaster in Henan's Wuzhi county.
translations.idiomatic: Wuzhi in Henan lost forty years of flood taxes.

sentences.zh: 乙未，上至曲阜，謁孔子廟。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, the Emperor reached Qufu and paid rites at the Temple of Confucius.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Hongli reached Qufu and worshipped at Confucius's temple.

sentences.zh: 蠲安徽懷寧等三十二州縣、建陽等七衛四十年水旱額賦。

translations.literal: Quota taxes were remitted for forty years of flood and drought disaster in thirty-two Anhui prefectures and counties including Huaining and in seven guards including Jianyang.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-two Anhui counties and seven guards lost forty years of flood and drought taxes.

sentences.zh: 丙申，釋奠先師孔子，告平兩金川功。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, the libation sacrifice to the Master was performed and the pacification of the Two Jinchuan was announced.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Hongli sacrificed to Confucius and announced the Two Jinchuan victory.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，上謁孔林。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, the Emperor paid rites at the Kong Forest.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Hongli worshipped at the Kong Forest.

sentences.zh: 調李質穎為廣東巡撫，以閔鶚元為安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: Li Zhiying was transferred to be Guangdong governor; Min E-yuan was made Anhui governor.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhiying took Guangdong; Min E-yuan, Anhui.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，富德褫職逮治。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Fu De was stripped of office and arrested for trial.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Fu De was stripped and arrested.

sentences.zh: 己亥，雲南車裡逃夷刀維屏等悔罪自歸，諭免死，錮之。

translations.literal: On day jihai, the fugitive Cheli yi Dao Weiping and others repented and returned of their own accord; they were instructed to be spared death and imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Cheli fugitive Dao Weiping and others surrendered and were imprisoned instead of executed.

sentences.zh: 庚子，命戶部侍郎和珅軍機處行走。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Household Vice Minister He Shen was ordered to serve in the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, He Shen joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，上奉皇太后自濟寧登舟。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, boarded a boat at Jining.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Hongli and the Empress Dowager sailed from Jining.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸卯，以平定金川，遣官祭告天地、太廟、社稷。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day guimao: because the Two Jinchuan had been pacified, officials were dispatched to report to Heaven, the Ancestral Temple, and the Altar of Soil and Grain.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4, guimao, officials reported the Jinchuan victory to Heaven, the Ancestral Temple, and the Altar of Soil and Grain.

sentences.zh: 以英廉兼署戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Yinglian was ordered additionally to act as Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Yinglian also acted as revenue minister.

sentences.zh: 命劉墉會同陳輝祖查勘湖北沔陽州沖潰堤工。

translations.literal: Liu Yong was ordered to join Chen Huizu in surveying the breached dikes at Mianyang subprefecture in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yong and Chen Huizu were sent to survey Hubei Mianyang's breached dikes.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，予告協辦大學士、吏部尚書官保卒。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, retired Associate Grand Secretary Guan Bao died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, retired associate grand secretary Guan Bao died.

sentences.zh: 丁未，上閱臨清州舊城。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the Emperor inspected the old city at Linqing subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Hongli inspected Linqing's old city.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，命阿桂仍在軍機處行走。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Agui was ordered to continue serving in the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Agui remained on the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，蠲直隸霸州等五十二州縣四十年水災額賦有差。

translations.literal: On day guichou, quota taxes were remitted for forty years of flood disaster in fifty-two Zhili prefectures and counties including Bazhou, with differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, fifty-two Zhili flood counties lost forty years of taxes, by degree.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以平定金川，遣官告祭昭西陵、孝陵、孝東陵、景陵、泰陵、孝賢皇后陵。

translations.literal: Because the Two Jinchuan had been pacified, officials were dispatched to report at the Western Zhao Tombs, Xiaoling, Xiao East Tombs, Jing Tomb, Tailing, and Empress Xiaoxian's tomb.
translations.idiomatic: Officials reported the Jinchuan victory at the Western Zhao, Xiaoling, Xiao East, Jing, Tailing, and Empress Xiaoxian tombs.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，遣官告祭孔子闕里。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, officials were dispatched to report at Confucius's home in Qufu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, officials reported the victory at Confucius's Qufu shrine.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，遣官告祭永陵、福陵、昭陵。

translations.literal: On day renxu, officials were dispatched to report at Yong Tomb, Fu Tomb, and Zhao Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, officials reported the victory at Yong, Fu, and Zhao tombs.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以阿思哈為漕運總督，素爾訥為左都御史，索琳為理藩院尚書，仍留庫倫辦事，命豐升額署理藩院尚書。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Asiha was made grain-transport governor-general; Suo'erne was made Left Censor-in-Chief; Suolin was made Minister of Colonial Affairs while remaining on business at Kulun; Feng Sheng'e was ordered to act as Minister of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Asiha took grain transport; Suo'erne, the censorate; Suolin stayed at Kulun as colonial minister; Feng Sheng'e acted for him.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，上送皇太后自寶稼營還京師。

translations.literal: On day yichou, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager from Baojia camp back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Hongli sent the Empress Dowager home from Baojia camp.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，獻金川俘馘於廟社。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Jinchuan captives and heads were presented at the temple and altar.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Jinchuan captives and heads were presented at the temple and altar.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，定西將軍阿桂等凱旋。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, General Who Pacifies the West Agui and others returned in triumph.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Dingxi General Agui returned in triumph.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，上幸良鄉城南行郊勞禮，賜將軍及隨征將士等宴，並賞阿桂等御用鞍馬各一。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, the Emperor went to the southern outskirts of Liangxiang to perform the suburban rites of congratulation on the campaign, feasted the general and the officers and soldiers who had accompanied the expedition, and bestowed on Agui and others one imperial saddle and horse each.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Hongli feasted Agui's army at Liangxiang with suburban victory rites and imperial saddlery.

sentences.zh: 上還京師。

translations.literal: The Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Hongli returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 己巳，受俘。

translations.literal: On day jisi, captives were received.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, the court received the captives.

sentences.zh: 上御瀛台，親鞫俘囚。

translations.literal: The Emperor went to the Ocean Terrace and personally interrogated the captive prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: Hongli interrogated the prisoners at the Ocean Terrace.

sentences.zh: 索諾木等皆磔於市。

translations.literal: Sonom and others were all executed by dismemberment in the market.
translations.idiomatic: Sonom and his party were dismembered in public.

sentences.zh: 上御紫光閣，行飲至禮，賜凱旋將士及王大臣等宴，賜將軍阿桂以下銀幣有差。

translations.literal: The Emperor went to the Hall of Purple Splendor, performed the rite of drinking to the army's arrival, feasted the returning soldiers and princes and grand ministers, and granted silver coins to General Agui and those below, with differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: At the Purple Splendor Pavilion Hongli held a victory feast and granted silver to Agui and his officers.

sentences.zh: 庚午，斬番目布籠普占巴、雅瑪朋阿庫魯等於市。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, the Tibetan chiefs Bulungpuzhaba and Yamapeng Akuru were beheaded in the market.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Tibetan chiefs Bulungpuzhaba and Yamapeng Akuru were executed in public.

sentences.zh: 五月辛未朔，上奉皇太后御慈寧宮，上徽號曰崇慶慈宣康惠敦和裕壽純禧恭懿安祺寧豫皇太后，頒詔覃恩有差。

translations.literal: Fifth month, new moon on day xinwei: the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, went to Cining Palace; the honorific title Chongqing Cixuan Kanghui Dunhe Yushou Chunxi Gongyi Anqi Ningyu Empress Dowager was ceremonially offered; an amnesty edict was issued with differing favors.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifth-month new moon, Hongli and the Empress Dowager at Cining offered a long honorific and a graded amnesty.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，富德以誣訐阿桂悖逆，處斬。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Fu De was executed for slandering Agui with treason and rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Fu De was executed for accusing Agui of treason.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，豁山西石樓等三縣丁徭虛額銀。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, void corvée quota silver for three Shanxi counties including Shilou was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, three Shanxi counties including Shilou lost void corvée quota silver.

sentences.zh: 癸未，上奉皇太后啟鑾，秋獮木蘭。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, set out on the autumn hunt at Mulan.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Hongli and the Empress Dowager left for the Mulan autumn hunt.

sentences.zh: 己丑，上駐蹕避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day jichou, the Emperor halted at the Mountain Resort for Escaping Summer Heat.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Hongli reached the Summer Resort.

sentences.zh: 六月庚子朔，定文淵閣官制。

translations.literal: Sixth month, new moon on day gengzi: the regulations of the Wenyuan Pavilion were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: At the sixth-month new moon, Wenyuan Pavilion regulations were fixed.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以甘肅皋蘭等二十九州縣廳旱災，命多留市米以供民食。

translations.literal: On day renzi, because of drought disaster in twenty-nine Gansu prefectures, counties, and departments including Gaolan, an order was issued to retain more market grain for the people's food.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, twenty-nine drought-stricken Gansu districts were told to keep more market grain.

sentences.zh: 庚申，黃邦寧論斬，逮治前護廣西巡撫蘇爾德、署按察使廣德。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Huang Bangning was sentenced to decapitation; the former acting Guangxi governor Surde and the acting provincial judge Guangde were arrested for trial.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Huang Bangning was condemned to death and former Guangxi officials Surde and Guangde were arrested.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚申，索琳以不職鐫級，以伍彌泰為理藩院尚書。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day gengshen: Suolin was demoted in rank for dereliction of duty; Wu Mitai was made Minister of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7, gengshen, Suolin was demoted for incompetence and Wu Mitai took colonial affairs.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，授巴延三山西巡撫，調鄂寶為湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Bayansan was appointed Shanxi governor; E Bao was transferred to be Hunan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Bayansan took Shanxi and E Bao, Hunan.

sentences.zh: 八月丁未，召瑚圖靈阿，以巴林王巴圖為定邊左副將軍，以額駙拉旺多爾濟為伊犁參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dingwei: Huturiangga was summoned; the Ba Lin prince Batu was made western frontier left deputy general; the imperial son-in-law Lawangdorji was made Yili expedition minister.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, dingwei, Huturiangga was recalled; Prince Batu of Ba Lin became western deputy general and Lawangdorji, Yili minister.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，上幸木蘭行圍。

translations.literal: On day yimao, the Emperor went to Mulan for the enclosure hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Hongli hunted at Mulan.

sentences.zh: 九月丙子，上回駐避暑山莊。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingzi: the Emperor returned to halt at the Mountain Resort for Escaping Summer Heat.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, bingzi, Hongli returned to the Summer Resort.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，上送皇太后迴鑾。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager on her return journey.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Hongli escorted the Empress Dowager homeward.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，上奉皇太后還京師。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Hongli and the Empress Dowager returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己亥朔，命豐升額為步軍統領，福隆安仍兼管。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, new moon on day jihai: Feng Sheng'e was made commander of the Metropolitan Garrison; Fu Long'an was still ordered to manage it concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: On the tenth-month new moon, Feng Sheng'e took the Metropolitan Garrison and Fu Long'an kept concurrent charge.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，綏遠城將軍容保罷，以伍彌泰代之。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Suiyuan city general Rongbao was dismissed; Wu Mitai replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Rongbao left Suiyuan; Wu Mitai took the post.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，命英誠公阿克棟阿在領侍衛內大臣上行走，以奎林為理藩院尚書。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Duke Yingcheng Akedong'a was ordered to serve at the imperial bodyguard grand minister rank; Kui Lin was made Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Akedong'a joined the inner guard grand ministers; Kui Lin took the Lifan yuan.

sentences.zh: 戊申，左都御史張若溎病免。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Left Censor-in-Chief Zhang Ruoshi was dismissed on account of illness.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Zhang Ruoshi left the censorate for illness.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，調崔應階為左都御史，以余文儀為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Cui Yingjie was transferred to be Left Censor-in-Chief; Yu Wenyi was made Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Cui Yingjie took the left censorate; Yu Wenyi, punishments.

sentences.zh: 壬子，阿思哈病免，以鄂寶為漕運總督。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Asiha was dismissed on account of illness; E Bao was made Grand Canal transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, ill Asiha was replaced by E Bao as canal transport governor-general.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以敦福為湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Dunfu was made Hunan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Dunfu became Hunan governor.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，命三寶查浙江漕糧積弊。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Sanbao was ordered to investigate accumulated abuses in Zhejiang grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Sanbao was sent to probe Zhejiang canal abuses.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以甘肅皋蘭等二十九廳州縣旱災，豁歷年積欠倉糧四百萬有奇。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, because of drought in twenty-nine Gansu prefectures and counties including Gaolan, accumulated arrears of stored grain exceeding four million piculs were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Gaolan and twenty-eight other Gansu districts were forgiven over four million piculs of stored-grain arrears from drought.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲申，命四庫全書館詳覈違禁各書，分別改毀。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiashen: the Siku Quanshu project was ordered to examine in detail all forbidden books and revise or destroy them separately.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, jiashen, the Siku Quanshu staff were told to review banned books and revise or destroy each as needed.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「明季諸人書集詞意抵觸本朝者，如錢謙益等，均不能死節，妄肆狂狺，自應查明毀棄。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Writings of late-Ming figures whose wording offends this dynasty, such as Qian Qianyi and others, who all failed to die loyal to their sovereign and wildly uttered slander, should upon investigation be destroyed."
translations.idiomatic: Hongli ruled that late-Ming writers who insulted the dynasty, like Qian Qianyi, should be found and destroyed for disloyal rantings.

sentences.zh: 劉宗周、黃道周立朝守正，熊廷弼材優幹濟，諸人所言，若當時採用，敗亡未必若彼其速，惟當改易字句，無庸銷毀。

translations.literal: Liu Zongzhou and Huang Daozhou upheld rectitude in office; Xiong Tingbi's talent and administrative ability were outstanding; had their words been adopted at the time, collapse might not have come so quickly—only the wording should be changed, with no need to destroy the works entirely.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zongzhou, Huang Daozhou, and the capable Xiong Tingbi deserved wording changes, not destruction, since their counsel might have slowed the Ming fall.

sentences.zh: 又直臣如楊漣等，即有一二語傷觸，亦止須酌改，實不忍並從焚棄。

translations.literal: Moreover, upright ministers such as Yang Lian, even if one or two phrases gave offense, need only be revised on discretion; it would truly be unbearable to burn them all together.
translations.idiomatic: Straight ministers like Yang Lian needed only selective edits for a few offending lines, not wholesale burning.
The edict closed.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚子，命戊戌年八月舉行翻譯鄉試，次年三月舉行會試。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day gengzi: the translation-service provincial examination was ordered held in the eighth month of the wuxu year, with the metropolitan examination in the third month of the following year.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, gengzi, the Manchu translation exams were set for wuxu month 8 and the metropolitan exam the next third month.

sentences.zh: 丙午，命明亮軍機處行走，伍彌泰遷西安將軍，博成署綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Mingliang was ordered to serve at the Grand Council; Wu Mitai was transferred to Xi'an general; Bocheng acted as Suiyuan city general.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Mingliang joined the Grand Council; Wu Mitai took Xi'an; Bocheng acted at Suiyuan.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以雅朗阿為綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Yalang'a was made Suiyuan city general.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Yalang'a became Suiyuan general.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，蠲山東德州等三十州縣衛所本年被災額賦。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, quota taxes for this year were remitted for disaster in thirty Shandong prefectures, counties, guards, and posts including Dezhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, thirty Shandong disaster districts including Dezhou lost this year's taxes.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，緬目得魯蘊請送還內地官人，准其入貢。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, the Burmese headman Deruyun requested to return inland officials; tribute entry was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Burma's Deruyun was allowed to return Qing officials and pay tribute.

sentences.zh: 諭令進京乞恩。

translations.literal: They were ordered to come to the capital to beg imperial favor.
translations.idiomatic: He was told to come to Beijing to seek grace.

sentences.zh: 戊午，上幸瀛台。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, the Emperor went to Yingtai.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Hongli went to Yingtai.

sentences.zh: 庫車阿奇木伯克、哈薩克使人，及四川明正土司等瞻覲，各賜冠服有差。

translations.literal: The Aksu beg of Kucha, Kazakh envoys, and the Mingzheng chieftain of Sichuan and others paid audience; each was granted graded caps and robes.
translations.idiomatic: Kucha, Kazakh, and Sichuan Mingzheng envoys were received and given graded dress.

sentences.zh: 四十二年春正月戊辰朔，蠲甘肅乾隆二十三年至三十五年民欠銀八十四萬兩有奇。

translations.literal: Forty-second year, spring, first month, new moon on day wuchen: civilian tax arrears in Gansu from Qianlong 23 through 35 totaling more than 840,000 taels were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 42, spring, wuchen new moon, Gansu owed over 840,000 taels from years 23–35 were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 丙子，上御閱武樓閱兵，命諸王、大臣、外藩蒙古及回部、庫車、哈薩克使臣、金川土司等從觀。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, the Emperor reviewed troops at the military review tower and ordered princes, grand ministers, Outer Mongol nobles, Muslims, Kucha and Kazakh envoys, Jinchuan chieftains, and others to attend.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Hongli reviewed troops and had princes, ministers, Mongols, Muslims, envoys, and Jinchuan chiefs watch.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以皇太后不豫，詣長春仙館問安，奉皇太后幸同樂園，侍晚饍。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, because the Empress Dowager was unwell, he went to Changchun Immortal Hall to inquire after her health, escorted the Empress Dowager to the Garden of Shared Pleasures, and attended her evening meal.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, with the Empress Dowager ill, Hongli called at Changchun Immortal Hall and dined with her at the Garden of Shared Pleasures.

sentences.zh: 自是每日詣長春仙館請安。

translations.literal: From this on he went daily to Changchun Immortal Hall to pay respects.
translations.idiomatic: He thereafter visited Changchun Immortal Hall daily.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以圖思德奏緬番內附，命阿桂往雲南籌辦。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, because Tusi'de memorialized that Burmese tribes had submitted inward, Agui was ordered to go to Yunnan to arrange affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, with Burma submitting, Agui was sent to Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 調李侍堯為雲貴總督，以楊景素為兩度總督，郝碩為山東巡撫，圖思德回貴州巡撫，裴宗錫回雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: Li Shiyao was transferred to Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general; Yang Jingsu to Liangguang governor-general; Hao Shuo to Shandong governor; Tusi'de returned to Guizhou governor; Pei Zongxi returned to Yunnan governor.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shiyao took Yunnan-Guizhou; Yang Jingsu, Liangguang; Hao Shuo, Shandong; Tusi'de, Guizhou; Pei Zongxi, Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 己丑，宥熊學鵬罪，蘇爾德、廣德論斬。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Xiong Xuepeng's crime was pardoned; Su Erde and Guangde were sentenced to decapitation.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Xiong Xuepeng was pardoned; Su Erde and Guangde were condemned to death.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，皇太后崩，奉安於慈寧宮正殿，上以含清齋為倚廬，頒大行皇太后遺詔。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, the Empress Dowager died; her coffin was placed in the main hall of Cining Palace; the Emperor made Hanqing Studio his mourning lodge and promulgated the late Empress Dowager's testamentary edict.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, the Empress Dowager died; Hongli mourned at Hanqing Studio and issued her final edict.

sentences.zh: 諭穿孝百日，王大臣官員等二十七日除服。

translations.literal: An edict ordered mourning dress for one hundred days; princes, grand ministers, and officials were to leave mourning after twenty-seven days.
translations.idiomatic: Hongli ordered a hundred days of mourning for himself and twenty-seven for officials.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，尊大行皇太后諡號為孝聖憲皇后，推恩普免錢糧一次。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, the late Empress Dowager was given the posthumous title Empress Xiaoshengxian; grace was extended by a universal remission of taxes and grain once.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, she became Empress Xiaoshengxian and taxes were remitted once nationwide.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，定二十七日內郊廟社稷遣官致祭用樂之制。

translations.literal: On day renchen, regulations were fixed for dispatching officials to sacrifice at suburban altars and the altars of soil and grain with music within the twenty-seven-day period.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, ritual music rules were set for state sacrifices during the twenty-seven-day mourning.

sentences.zh: 乙未，尊大行皇太后陵曰泰東陵。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, the late Empress Dowager's tomb was titled Tai Dongling.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, her tomb was named Tai Dongling.

sentences.zh: 丙申，移大行皇太后梓宮於暢春園，奉安於九經三事殿。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, the late Empress Dowager's coffin was moved to the Garden of Everlasting Spring and placed in the Hall of the Nine Classics and Three Matters.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, her coffin went to the Garden of Everlasting Spring's Nine Classics Hall.

sentences.zh: 上居圓明園。

translations.literal: The Emperor resided at the Old Summer Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Hongli stayed at the Old Summer Palace.

sentences.zh: 二月丁酉朔，上詣安佑宮行告哀禮。

translations.literal: Second month, new moon on day dingyou: the Emperor went to Anyou Palace to perform the rite of announcing grief.
translations.idiomatic: On month 2 dingyou new moon, Hongli announced grief at Anyou Palace.

sentences.zh: 上居無逸齋苫次。

translations.literal: The Emperor dwelt in mourning garb at the Wuyi Studio.
translations.idiomatic: Hongli mourned at the Wuyi Studio.

sentences.zh: 己亥，上還居圓明園。

translations.literal: On day jihai, the Emperor returned to reside at the Old Summer Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Hongli returned to the Old Summer Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚子，上詣九經三事殿大行皇太后梓宮前供奠。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, the Emperor went before the late Empress Dowager's coffin in the Hall of the Nine Classics and Three Matters to offer sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Hongli offered sacrifice before her coffin.

sentences.zh: 諸王大臣請間一二日行禮，不允。

translations.literal: Princes and grand ministers requested that sacrifices be performed at intervals of a day or two; this was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: Princes asked to mourn every other day; Hongli refused.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，諭二十七月內停止元旦朝賀。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, it was ordered that New Year's court congratulations be suspended within the twenty-seven-day period.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, New Year court rites were halted for twenty-seven days.

sentences.zh: 其百日後，尋常御殿視朝，屆日請旨。

translations.literal: After the hundred days, ordinary audience at the main hall would resume, with the date to be requested by edict when the day arrived.
translations.idiomatic: After a hundred days, normal audiences would resume on imperial order.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，定百日內與二十七月內御用服色及臣下服色制。

translations.literal: On day yisi, regulations were fixed for imperial and official mourning dress during the hundred days and during the twenty-seven-day period.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, mourning dress rules were set for court and officials.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，高晉會同阿揚阿赴安徽查案，楊魁兼署兩江總督。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Gao Jin together with Ayangga went to Anhui to investigate a case; Yang Kui concurrently acted as Liangjiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Gao Jin and Ayangga investigated Anhui; Yang Kui acted as Liangjiang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 蠲安徽宿州等八州縣、鳳陽等三衛四十一年水災額賦。

translations.literal: Quota taxes were remitted for the year 41 flood disaster in eight Anhui prefectures and counties including Suzhou and three guards including Fengyang.
translations.idiomatic: Eight Anhui counties and three guards lost year-41 flood taxes.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，上詣九經三事殿大行皇太后梓宮前行月祭禮。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, the Emperor went before the late Empress Dowager's coffin in the Hall of the Nine Classics and Three Matters to perform the monthly sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Hongli performed the monthly mourning rite before her coffin.

sentences.zh: 以顏希深為湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: Yan Xishen was made Hunan governor.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Xishen became Hunan governor.

sentences.zh: 三月辛未，左都御史素爾訥、大理寺卿尹嘉銓休致。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinwei: Left Censor-in-Chief Su Erne and Grand Court Judge Yin Jiaquan were granted permission to retire.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, xinwei, Su Erne and Yin Jiaquan retired.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以薩載赴京，命德保兼署江南河道總督。

translations.literal: On day renshen, because Sa Zai was coming to the capital, Debao was ordered concurrently to act as Jiangnan canal transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, with Sa Zai bound for Beijing, Debao acted as Jiangnan canal governor-general.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以邁拉遜為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Mailasun was made Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Mailasun took the left censorate.

sentences.zh: 壬午，上大行皇太后尊諡曰孝聖慈宣康惠敦和敬天光聖憲皇后。

translations.literal: On day renwu, the late Empress Dowager was given the full honorific title Empress Xiaosheng Cixuan Kanghui Dunhe Jingtian Guangshengxian.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, she received the full posthumous title Empress Xiaosheng Cixuan Kanghui Dunhe Jingtian Guangshengxian.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以恆山保為烏里雅蘇台參贊大臣。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Hengshanbao was made Uliasutai assistant commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Hengshanbao became Uliasutai assistant commissioner.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊戌，以緬番投誠反覆，召阿桂回京，留緬目所遣孟幹等。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wuxu: because Burmese tribes' submission was treacherous and changeable, Agui was recalled to the capital; the Menggan envoys sent by the Burmese headmen were detained.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4, wuxu, treacherous Burmese submission recalled Agui and detained Menggan envoys.

sentences.zh: 戊申，上詣九經三事殿孝聖憲皇后梓宮前行祖奠禮。

translations.literal: On day wushen, the Emperor went before Empress Xiaoshengxian's coffin in the Hall of the Nine Classics and Three Matters to perform the pre-departure sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Hongli performed the pre-departure rite before her coffin.

sentences.zh: 己酉，孝聖憲皇后發引，上送往泰東陵，免經過州縣本年額賦十分之七。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Empress Xiaoshengxian's funeral procession set out; the Emperor escorted it to Tai Dongling and remitted seven-tenths of this year's quota taxes for prefectures and counties along the route.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Hongli escorted her coffin to Tai Dongling and cut route taxes by seven-tenths.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，上謁泰陵。

translations.literal: On day guichou, the Emperor visited Tailing.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Hongli visited Tailing.

sentences.zh: 是日，孝聖憲皇后梓宮至泰東陵，奉安於隆恩殿。

translations.literal: That day, Empress Xiaoshengxian's coffin reached Tai Dongling and was placed in the Hall of Imperial Favor.
translations.idiomatic: That day her coffin reached Tai Dongling's Hall of Imperial Favor.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，上詣泰東陵孝聖憲皇后梓宮前行百日祭禮。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, the Emperor went before Empress Xiaoshengxian's coffin at Tai Dongling to perform the hundred-day sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Hongli performed the hundred-day rite at Tai Dongling.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，大學士舒赫德卒。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Grand Secretary Shuhede died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Grand Secretary Shuhede died.

sentences.zh: 戊午，命永貴署大學士兼吏部尚書。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Yonggui was ordered to act as grand secretary while also managing the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Yonggui acted as grand secretary and personnel minister.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，蠲安徽宿州等八州縣、長河等三衛四十一年水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, quota taxes were remitted for the year 41 flood in eight Anhui prefectures and counties including Suzhou and three guards including Changhe.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, eight Anhui counties and three guards lost year-41 flood taxes.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，命福隆安兼署吏部尚書。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Fulong'an was ordered concurrently to act as Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Fulong'an also acted as personnel minister.

sentences.zh: 甲子，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Hongli returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 五月乙丑朔，孝聖憲皇后神牌升祔太廟。

translations.literal: Fifth month, new moon on day yichou: Empress Xiaoshengxian's spirit tablet was elevated for joint worship in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On month 5 yichou new moon, her tablet entered the Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 翌日，頒詔覃恩有差。

translations.literal: The next day, an edict extending grace with differentiated favors was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: The next day Hongli issued a grace edict.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，上臨舒赫德喪次賜奠。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, the Emperor in person went to Shuhede's mourning site to grant condolence sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Hongli mourned Shuhede in person.

sentences.zh: 壬申，蠲直隸清苑等十州縣逋賦。

translations.literal: On day renshen, accumulated tax arrears were remitted for ten Zhili prefectures and counties including Qingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, ten Zhili districts including Qingyuan were forgiven back taxes.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以普蠲全國錢糧，免福建台灣府屬官莊租息十分之三。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, because taxes and grain were universally remitted nationwide, three-tenths of official-estate rent interest in Taiwan dependency of Fujian was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Taiwan official estates lost three-tenths of rent after the national remission.

sentences.zh: 甲申，馬蘭鎮總兵滿斗於東陵掘牆通路，論斬。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Malan garrison commander Mandou excavated a wall and opened a road at the Eastern Tombs; he was sentenced to decapitation.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Mandou was condemned to death for breaching the Eastern Tombs wall.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，命阿桂為武英殿大學士，兼管吏部事，英廉協辦大學士。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Agui was made Wuying Hall grand secretary and ordered to manage Ministry of Personnel affairs; Yinglian was made associate grand secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Agui became Wuying grand secretary over personnel; Yinglian, associate grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 命尚書果毅繼勇公豐升額之父阿里袞原襲果毅公爵號，亦加「繼勇」二字。

translations.literal: It was ordered that Arigun, father of Minister and Duke Guoyi Jiyong Fengsheng'e, originally inheriting the Guoyi duke rank, should also have the characters "Jiyong" added to the title.
translations.idiomatic: Arigun, father of Duke Guoyi Jiyong Fengsheng'e, was granted the added title Jiyong on the Guoyi dukedom.

sentences.zh: 調永貴為吏部尚書，以富勒渾為禮部尚書，三寶為湖廣總督，王亶望為浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: Yonggui was transferred to Minister of Personnel; Fulehun was made Minister of Rites; Sanbao was made Huguang governor-general; Wang Tanwang was made Zhejiang governor.
translations.idiomatic: Yonggui took personnel; Fulehun, rites; Sanbao, Huguang; Wang Tanwang, Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 蠲順天直隸大興等三十三廳州縣被災額賦。

translations.literal: Quota taxes were remitted for disaster in thirty-three Shuntian and Zhili prefectures, departments, and counties including Daxing.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-three Shuntian and Zhili disaster districts including Daxing lost quota taxes.

sentences.zh: 六月乙卯，以吉林將軍富椿調杭州將軍，命福康安代之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yimao: Jilin general Fuchun was transferred to Hangzhou general; Fukang'an was ordered to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, yimao, Fuchun took Hangzhou; Fukang'an replaced him at Jilin.

sentences.zh: 己未，上詣黑龍潭祈雨。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, the Emperor went to Black Dragon Pool to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Hongli prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，蠲甘肅皋蘭等二十九廳州縣四十一年被災額賦。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month: quota taxes were remitted for the year 41 disaster in twenty-nine Gansu prefectures, departments, and counties including Gaolan.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7, twenty-nine Gansu districts including Gaolan lost year-41 disaster taxes.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，命甘肅應徵各屬番糧草束免十分之三。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, it was ordered that tribute grain, fodder, and straw bundles levied from various dependent tribes in Gansu be remitted by three-tenths.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Gansu tribal grain and fodder levies were cut by three-tenths.

sentences.zh: 暹羅頭目鄭昭進貢，送所獲緬番，諭楊景素以請封檄諭之。

translations.literal: Siam headman Zheng Zhao presented tribute, sending captured Burmese; Yang Jingsu was instructed to address him with a patent of enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Zhao of Siam sent tribute and Burmese captives; Yang Jingsu was told to enfeoff him.

sentences.zh: 八月庚子，免烏魯木齊各州縣戶民額糧十分之三。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengzi: three-tenths of quota grain for civilian households in various Urumqi prefectures and counties were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, gengzi, Urumqi households lost three-tenths of quota grain.

sentences.zh: 庚申，命侍郎金簡赴吉林，會同福康安查辦事件。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Vice Minister Jin Jian was ordered to go to Jilin to join Fukang'an in investigating and handling matters.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Jin Jian was sent to Jilin to investigate with Fukang'an.

sentences.zh: 九月丙子，上謁泰陵、泰東陵。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingzi: the Emperor visited Tailing and Tai Dongling.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, bingzi, Hongli visited Tailing and Tai Dongling.

sentences.zh: 壬午，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day renwu, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Hongli returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊戌，戶部尚書果毅繼勇公豐升額卒，調英廉為戶部尚書，仍兼管刑部，命德福為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wuxu: Minister of Revenue and Duke Guoyi Jiyong Fengsheng'e died; Yinglian was transferred to Minister of Revenue while still also managing punishments; Defu was made Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In month 10, wuxu, Fengsheng'e died; Yinglian took revenue and kept punishments; Defu, punishments minister.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔陝西民屯租糧草束屆輪免錢糧之年，一體蠲免。

translations.literal: On day yisi, an edict stated that for Shaanxi civilian colony rent grain and fodder straw, in years when rotating universal remissions fell due, all should be remitted together.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Shaanxi colony rent and fodder were remitted in universal remission years.

sentences.zh: 庚申，設密雲副都統一，駐防兵二千。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, one Miyun deputy lieutenant-general was established with two thousand garrison troops.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Miyun gained a deputy commander and two thousand troops.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，命袁守侗赴浙江查審歸安縣知縣劉均被控案。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Yuan Shoutong was ordered to go to Zhejiang to investigate the case against Gui'an county magistrate Liu Jun.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Yuan Shoutong was sent to try Gui'an magistrate Liu Jun in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 命侍郎周煌、阿揚阿赴四川查審大足縣知縣趙憲高被控案。

translations.literal: Vice Ministers Zhou Huang and Ayangga were ordered to go to Sichuan to investigate the case against Dazu county magistrate Zhao Xiangao.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Huang and Ayangga were sent to try Dazu magistrate Zhao Xiangao in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙寅，廣德處斬。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingyin: Guangde was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, bingyin, Guangde was executed.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，海成以縱庇王錫侯褫職，以郝碩為江西巡撫，國泰為山東巡撫。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Haicheng was stripped of office for shielding Wang Xihu; Hao Shuo was made Jiangxi governor; Guotai was made Shandong governor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Haicheng lost his post for shielding Wang Xihu; Hao Shuo took Jiangxi; Guotai, Shandong.

sentences.zh: 壬申，刑部尚書余文儀乞休，允之。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Minister of Punishments Yu Wenyi requested retirement; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Yu Wenyi retired from punishments.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，調袁守侗為刑部尚書，梁國治為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Yuan Shoutong was transferred to Minister of Punishments; Liang Guozhi was made Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Yuan Shoutong took punishments; Liang Guozhi, revenue.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，蠲甘肅寧夏等七廳縣本年被災額賦。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, quota taxes were remitted for this year's disaster in seven Gansu prefectures and counties including Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, seven Gansu districts including Ningxia lost this year's disaster taxes.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁酉，蠲甘肅皋蘭等十七州縣四十一年被災額賦。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dingyou: quota taxes were remitted for the year 41 disaster in seventeen Gansu prefectures and counties including Gaolan.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, dingyou, seventeen Gansu districts including Gaolan lost year-41 disaster taxes.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，賑甘肅皋蘭等三十二廳州縣被旱災民。

translations.literal: On day guichou, drought victims were relieved in thirty-two Gansu prefectures, departments, and counties including Gaolan.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, thirty-two drought-stricken Gansu districts were relieved.

sentences.zh: 四十三年春正月壬戌朔，免朝賀。

translations.literal: Forty-third year, spring, first month, new moon on day renxu: court congratulations were waived.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 43, spring, renxu new moon, court congratulations were skipped.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以鄭大進為河南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Zheng Dajin was made Henan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Zheng Dajin became Henan governor.

sentences.zh: 辛未，追復睿親王封爵及豫親王多鐸、禮親王代善、鄭親王濟爾哈朗、肅親王豪格、克勤郡王岳託原爵，並配享太廟。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, the princely ranks of Prince Rui and Prince Yu Duoduo, Prince Li Daishan, Prince Zheng Jirhalang, Prince Su Hooge, and Prince Keqin Yoto were posthumously restored to their original titles, and they were given joint worship in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Princes Rui, Yu, Li, Zheng, Su, and Keqin regained their titles and Ancestral Temple worship.

sentences.zh: 己卯，上謁西陵，免經過地方本年額賦十分之三。

translations.literal: On day jimao, the Emperor visited the Western Tombs and remitted three-tenths of this year's quota taxes for places along the route.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Hongli visited the Western Tombs and cut route taxes by three-tenths.

sentences.zh: 癸未，上謁泰陵、泰東陵。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, the Emperor visited Tailing and Tai Dongling.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Hongli visited Tailing and Tai Dongling.

sentences.zh: 甲申，上謁泰東陵行期年禮。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, the Emperor visited Tai Dongling to perform the first-anniversary rites.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Hongli performed the first-anniversary rites at Tai Dongling.

sentences.zh: 二月丁酉，朝鮮、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: Second month, day dingyou: Korea and Ryukyu presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Korea and Ryukyu paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以特成額為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Tekencheng'e was made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Tekencheng'e became Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 調綽克托為吏部尚書，富勒渾為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Zhuoketuo was transferred to Minister of Personnel; Fulehun to Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuoketuo took Personnel and Fulehun took Works.

sentences.zh: 特成額遷成都將軍，以鍾音為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Tekencheng'e was transferred to Chengdu General; Zhong Yin was made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Tekencheng'e went to Chengdu and Zhong Yin took Rites.

sentences.zh: 調楊景素為閩浙總督，桂林為兩廣總督，李質穎護之。

translations.literal: Yang Jingsu was transferred to Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general; Gui Lin to Guangdong-Guangxi governor-general, with Li Zhiying as protector.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Jingsu took Fujian-Zhejiang; Gui Lin took Guangdong-Guangxi; Li Zhiying was protector.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以諴親王弘申昜為正白旗領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Prince Xian of the First Rank Hong Shenyi was made chief grand secretary of the Plain White Banner guard.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Prince Xian Hong Shenyi headed the Plain White Banner guard.

sentences.zh: 三月甲子，上詣西陵。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiazi: the Emperor went to the Western Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, the Emperor went to the Western Tombs.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，上謁泰陵、泰東陵。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, the Emperor visited the Tai Tomb and Tai East Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, the Emperor visited the Tai and Tai East Tombs.

sentences.zh: 己巳，上親祭泰東陵。

translations.literal: On day jisi, the Emperor personally sacrificed at the Tai East Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, the Emperor sacrificed at the Tai East Tomb.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，上閱健銳營兵。

translations.literal: On day yihai, the Emperor reviewed troops of the Vanguard Camp.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, the Emperor reviewed Vanguard Camp troops.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以李湖為湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Li Hu was made Hunan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Li Hu became Hunan governor.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛卯，以河南旱，命減開封等五府軍流以下罪。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day xinmao: because of drought in Henan, military-exile and lesser crimes in five prefectures including Kaifeng were ordered reduced.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Henan drought led to reduced sentences in five prefectures.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，命先免河南四十五年田賦。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Henan's land-tax of the forty-fifth year was ordered remitted in advance.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Henan's forty-fifth-year land-tax was remitted early.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，肅親王蘊著卒。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Prince Su Yunzhuo died.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Prince Su Yunzhuo died.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，上詣黑龍潭祈雨。

translations.literal: On day yisi, the Emperor went to Black Dragon Pool to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, the Emperor prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，命減河南軍流以下罪。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Henan's military-exile and lesser crimes were ordered reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Henan sentences were again reduced.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，賜戴衢亨等一百五十七人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Dai Qiuheng and one hundred fifty-seven others were granted jinshi with rank and origin in varying grades.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, one hundred fifty-seven new jinshi including Dai Qiuheng received graded ranks.

sentences.zh: 五月庚申朔，以山東荒歉，命預免四十五年錢糧。

translations.literal: Fifth month, new moon on day gengshen: because of famine in Shandong, the forty-fifth year's taxes and grain were ordered remitted in advance.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifth-month new moon, Shandong's forty-fifth-year taxes were remitted early for famine.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，命山西巡撫兼理河東鹽政。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, the Shanxi governor was ordered also to administer Hedong salt affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, the Shanxi governor also took Hedong salt duties.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，怡親王弘曉卒。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Prince Yi Hongxiao died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Prince Yi Hongxiao died.

sentences.zh: 六月乙未，以九江關監督全德浮收，逮治之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yiwei: Quan De, supervisor of Jiujiang customs, was arrested and punished for excessive collection.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Jiujiang customs supervisor Quan De was arrested for over-collection.

sentences.zh: 閏六月癸亥，河南祥符河決。

translations.literal: Intercalary sixth month, day guihai: the Xiangfu River in Henan breached.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai in the intercalary sixth month, the Xiangfu River broke.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸巳，河南儀封考城河決。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day guisi: the Yifeng and Kaocheng rivers in Henan breached.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, the Yifeng and Kaocheng rivers broke.

sentences.zh: 乙未，命袁守侗往河南，會同河督姚立德、巡撫鄭大進查辦河工。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Yuan Shoutong was sent to Henan to join River Director Yao Lide and Governor Zheng Dajin in inspecting river works.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Yuan Shoutong joined Yao Lide and Zheng Dajin to inspect Henan river works.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，命高晉督辦堤工。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Gao Jin was ordered to supervise dike works.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Gao Jin was ordered to supervise dikes.

sentences.zh: 丁未，上詣盛京謁陵，免經過直隸、奉天各州縣本年額賦十分之三。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the Emperor went to pay respects at the Shengjing tombs and remitted one-third of this year's assessed taxes for districts along the route in Zhili and Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, the Emperor visited Shengjing tombs and remitted one-third of route taxes in Zhili and Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 八月癸酉，以儀封決河下注安徽鳳陽各州縣，諭薩載等賑災民。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guiyou: because the Yifeng breach sent the river down into Fengyang and other districts in Anhui, Sa Zai and others were instructed to relieve disaster victims.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Sa Zai and others were told to relieve Anhui flood victims from the Yifeng breach.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，上謁永陵。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, the Emperor visited Yong Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, the Emperor visited Yong Tomb.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，行大饗禮。

translations.literal: On day yihai, the grand feast rite was performed.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, the grand feast rite was performed.

sentences.zh: 己卯，上謁福陵。

translations.literal: On day jimao, the Emperor visited Fu Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, the Emperor visited Fu Tomb.

sentences.zh: 免奉天所屬府州縣明年丁賦。

translations.literal: Next year's poll-tax and grain assessments for Fengtian prefectures and counties were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Fengtian's next-year poll-tax and grain were remitted.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，行大饗禮。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, the grand feast rite was performed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, the grand feast rite was performed.

sentences.zh: 上謁昭陵。

translations.literal: The Emperor visited Zhao Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor visited Zhao Tomb.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，行大饗禮。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, the grand feast rite was performed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, the grand feast rite was performed.

sentences.zh: 命奉天、吉林、黑龍江各屬已結未結死罪均減等，軍流以下悉宥之。

translations.literal: Capital and capital crimes, settled and unsettled, in Fengtian, Jilin, and Heilongjiang were all reduced one grade; military exiles and lesser offenders were all pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the northeast, capital crimes were reduced and military exiles and lesser offenders pardoned.

sentences.zh: 癸未，上臨奠克勤郡王岳託墓。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, the Emperor personally mourned at the tomb of Prince Keqin Yuetuo.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, the Emperor mourned at Prince Keqin Yuetuo's tomb.

sentences.zh: 甲申，上臨奠武勛王揚古利、弘毅公額亦都、直義公費英東墓。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, the Emperor personally mourned at the tombs of Prince Wuxun Yangguli, Duke Hongyi Eidu, and Duke Zhiyi Feiyingdong.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, the Emperor mourned at the tombs of Yangguli, Eidu, and Feiyingdong.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，上詣文廟行禮。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, the Emperor performed rites at the Confucian temple.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, the Emperor worshipped at the Confucian temple.

sentences.zh: 九月甲午，錦縣生員金從善，以上言建儲立後，納諫施德，忤旨，論斬。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiawu: Jin Congshan, a licentiate of Jin County, memorialized on establishing an heir and receiving remonstrance and bestowing virtue; for offending the imperial will he was sentenced to decapitation.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Jin County licentiate Jin Congshan was sentenced to death for a memorial on the heir.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，禮部尚書鍾音卒。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Minister of Rites Zhong Yin died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Zhong Yin, minister of rites, died.

sentences.zh: 金從善以妄肆詆斥，處斬。

translations.literal: Jin Congshan was executed for wanton slander and abuse.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Congshan was executed for wanton slander.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以德保為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Debao was made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Debao became Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 丁未，申諭立儲流弊，及宣明歸政之期。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, an edict clarified abuses in installing an heir and announced the date for restoration of rule.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, an edict rebuked heir-installation abuses and fixed a date to restore rule.

sentences.zh: 壬子，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day renzi, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, the Emperor returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，高朴以婪贓論斬。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Gao Pu was sentenced to decapitation for extortion and bribery.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Gao Pu was sentenced to death for bribery.

sentences.zh: 綽克托以失察高朴褫職。

translations.literal: Zhuoketuo was stripped of office for failure to supervise Gao Pu.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuoketuo lost his post for failing to supervise Gao Pu.

sentences.zh: 命永貴為吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Yonggui was appointed Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Yonggui became Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，命邁拉遜署吏部尚書。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Mailasun was ordered to act as Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Mailasun acted as Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己未，以庚子年七旬萬壽，巡幸江、浙，命舉恩科鄉會試，並普蠲錢糧。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiwei: for the seventieth birthday in the gengzi year, the Emperor would tour Jiangsu and Zhejiang, holding grace civil examinations and universally remitting taxes and grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, a gengzi-year seventieth-birthday tour of Jiangsu and Zhejiang was ordered with grace exams and tax remissions.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，江蘇布政使陶易以徇縱徐述夔，褫職論斬。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Jiangsu intendant Tao Yi was stripped of office and sentenced to decapitation for indulging Xu Shuyao.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Tao Yi lost his post and was sentenced to death for indulging Xu Shuyao.

sentences.zh: 丙子，免甘肅皋蘭等三十二廳州縣四十二年旱災額賦。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, registered taxes for forty-two years' drought disaster in thirty-two Gansu departments and counties including Gaolan were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, thirty-two Gansu districts including Gaolan were forgiven drought taxes of year 42.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊子，禁貢獻整玉如意及大玉。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wuzi: tribute of whole jade ruyi scepters and large jade was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, whole jade ruyi and large jade tribute were banned.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，定驛務歸巡道分管，裁甘肅驛傳道。

translations.literal: On day renchen, courier affairs were assigned to touring circuit intendants and the Gansu courier commissioner was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, couriers were put under circuit intendants and the Gansu courier post was cut.

sentences.zh: 賑廣西興安等九州縣本年旱災。

translations.literal: Disaster relief was granted for this year's drought in nine Guangxi prefectures and counties including Xing'an.
translations.idiomatic: Nine Guangxi districts including Xing'an received drought relief.

sentences.zh: 庚子，免甘肅寧夏等七廳州縣四十二年被災額賦。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, registered taxes for forty-two years' disaster in seven Gansu departments and counties including Ningxia were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, seven Gansu districts including Ningxia were forgiven year-42 disaster taxes.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚申，河南儀封堤工塌壞，高晉等下部嚴議。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day gengshen: the Yifeng dike in Henan collapsed; Gao Jin and others were severely censured.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, the Yifeng dike failed and Gao Jin and others were severely censured.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，諭國泰嚴治山東冠縣義和拳教匪。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Guotai was instructed strictly to suppress the Yihoquan sect bandits in Guan County, Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Guotai was told to crush Yihoquan bandits in Guan County, Shandong.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，賑安徽當塗等三十四州縣衛本年水旱災、湖南湘陰等十五州縣衛旱災，並蠲額賦有差。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, relief was granted for this year's flood and drought in thirty-four Anhui prefectures and counties including Dangtu and for drought in fifteen Hunan prefectures and counties including Xiangyin, with varying remissions of registered taxes.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Anhui and Hunan disaster districts received relief and varying tax remissions.

sentences.zh: 四十四年春正月丙戌朔，調陳輝祖為河南巡撫，鄭大進為湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: Forty-fourth year, spring, first month, new moon on day bingxu: Chen Huizu was transferred to Henan governor and Zheng Dajin to Hubei governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the forty-fourth year's first-month new moon, Chen Huizu took Henan and Zheng Dajin took Hubei.

sentences.zh: 乙未，大學士、兩江總督高晉卒。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Grand Secretary and Jiangnan governor-general Gao Jin died.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Grand Secretary Gao Jin died in Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 命三寶為東閣大學士，仍留湖廣總督任，薩載為兩江總督，李奉翰為江南河道總督。

translations.literal: Sanbao was made Associate Grand Secretary while retaining Huguang governor-general; Sa Zai became Jiangnan governor-general and Li Fenghan Huai River conservancy director.
translations.idiomatic: Sanbao became associate grand secretary and kept Huguang; Sa Zai took Jiangnan and Li Fenghan the Huai conservancy.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，上詣西陵，免經過地方本年丁賦十分之三。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the Emperor went to the Western Tombs and remitted one-third of this year's poll-tax for districts along the route.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, the Emperor visited the Western Tombs and remitted one-third of route poll-tax.

sentences.zh: 裁福州副都統。

translations.literal: The Fuzhou deputy lieutenant-general was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Fuzhou deputy lieutenant-general post was cut.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，命阿桂赴河南查勘河工。

translations.literal: On day yisi, A Gui was ordered to Henan to survey river works.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, A Gui was sent to survey Henan river works.

sentences.zh: 丁未，上謁泰陵、泰東陵。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the Emperor visited the Tai Tomb and Tai East Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, the Emperor visited the Tai and Tai East Tombs.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, the Emperor returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 二月癸亥，左都御史邁拉遜病免。

translations.literal: Second month, day guihai: Left Censor-in-Chief Mailasun was dismissed on account of illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Mailasun left the left censorate for illness.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以增福為福建巡撫，申保為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Zeng Fu was made Fujian governor and Shen Bao left censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Zeng Fu took Fujian and Shen Bao became left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，命輯明季諸臣奏疏。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, compilation of memorials by Ming dynasty officials was ordered.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Ming official memorials were ordered compiled.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「各省送到違礙應毀書籍，如徐必達南州草，蕭近高疏草，宋一韓掖垣封事，切中彼時弊病者，俱無慚骨鯁。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Among prohibited books sent from the provinces, such as Xu Bidao's Nanzou Cao, Xiao Jingao's Shu Cao, and Song Yihan's Yeyuan Fengshi, which keenly struck at the abuses of the age—none shames forthright remonstrance.
translations.idiomatic: The throne said banned books like Xu Bidao's and Xiao Jingao's were honest remonstrance.

sentences.zh: 雖其君置若罔聞，而一時廢弛瞀亂之跡，痛切敷陳，足資考鏡。

translations.literal: Though their rulers pretended not to hear, their painful accounts of contemporary laxity and confusion serve as mirrors for study.
translations.idiomatic: Ignored by their rulers, those frank records still instruct.

sentences.zh: 朕以為不若擇其較有關係者，別加編錄，名為明季奏疏，勒成一書，永為殷鑒。

translations.literal: I deem it better to select the more relevant pieces, compile them separately under the title Ming-ji Memorials, fix them in one book, and keep them forever as a warning.
translations.idiomatic: Selected memorials would be published as Ming-ji Memorials for permanent warning.

sentences.zh: 諸臣在勝國言事，於我國家間有干犯之語，不宜深責，應量為改易選錄，餘仍分別撤毀。

translations.literal: Officials who spoke under the former dynasty sometimes used language touching our state; they should not be harshly blamed but should be edited in selection; the rest should still be destroyed by category.
translations.idiomatic: Former-dynasty language would be edited, not punished, while other books were destroyed.

sentences.zh: 」壬午，建江南龍泉庄等處行宮。

translations.literal: " On day renwu, imperial lodges were built at Longquanzhuang and elsewhere in Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Jiangnan lodges were built at Longquanzhuang and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 三月丙申，命英廉署直隸總督。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingshen: Yinglian was ordered to act as Zhili governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Yinglian acted as Zhili governor-general.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，命德福署協辦大學士。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Defu was ordered to act as associate grand secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Defu acted as associate grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 調楊景素為直隸總督，三寶為閩浙總督。

translations.literal: Yang Jingsu was transferred to Zhili governor-general; Sanbao to Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Jingsu took Zhili and Sanbao took Fujian-Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 以圖思德為湖廣總督，舒常為貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: Tusede was made Huguang governor-general; Shu Chang Guizhou governor.
translations.idiomatic: Tusede took Huguang and Shu Chang took Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以譚尚忠署山西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Tan Shangzhong was ordered to act as Shanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Tan Shangzhong acted as Shanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 己酉，賑湖北江夏等三十九州縣衛上年旱災。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, relief was granted for last year's drought in thirty-nine Hubei prefectures and counties including Jiangxia.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, thirty-nine Hubei districts including Jiangxia received drought relief.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己未，改辟展辦事大臣為吐魯番領隊大臣。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiwei: the Pizhan commissioner was changed to Turpan brigade commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, the Pizhan commissioner became Turpan brigade commander.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，上詣西陵。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, the Emperor went to the Western Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, the Emperor went to the Western Tombs.

sentences.zh: 壬申，上謁泰陵、泰東陵。

translations.literal: On day renshen, the Emperor visited the Tai Tomb and Tai East Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, the Emperor visited the Tai and Tai East Tombs.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，改甘肅驛傳道為分巡蘭州道。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, the Gansu courier commissioner was changed to the Lanzhou circuit intendant.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, the Gansu courier post became the Lanzhou circuit.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以袁守侗為河東河道總督，胡季堂為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Yuan Shoutong was made Hedong river conservancy director and Hu Jitang Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Yuan Shoutong took Hedong conservancy and Hu Jitang took Punishments.

sentences.zh: 己卯，上閱健銳營兵。

translations.literal: On day jimao, the Emperor reviewed troops of the Vanguard Camp.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, the Emperor reviewed Vanguard Camp troops.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, the Emperor returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 五月乙未，上秋獮木蘭，免經過地方本年丁賦十分之三。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yiwei: the Emperor went for autumn hunting at Mulan and remitted one-third of this year's poll-tax for districts along the route.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, the Emperor hunted at Mulan and remitted one-third of route poll-tax.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以李世傑為廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Li Shijie was made Guangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Li Shijie became Guangxi governor.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，上駐避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, the Emperor lodged at the Mountain Resort for Avoiding Summer Heat.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, the Emperor lodged at the Summer Resort.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以富綱為福建巡撫。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Fu Gang was made Fujian governor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Fu Gang became Fujian governor.

sentences.zh: 丁未，上詣文廟行釋奠禮。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the Emperor performed the libation rite at the Confucian temple.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, the Emperor performed the Confucian libation rite.

sentences.zh: 六月丁卯，免甘肅乾隆二十七年至三十七年逋賦銀二十三萬五千兩、糧一百零五萬石各有奇。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingmao: 235,000 taels of silver and 1,050,000-odd piculs of grain of Gansu tax arrears from Qianlong 27-37 were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Gansu arrears of 235,000 taels and over 1,050,000 piculs of grain were remitted.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，河南武陟、河內沁河決。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, the Qin River in Wuzhi and He'nei, Henan, breached.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, the Qin River broke at Wuzhi and He'nei in Henan.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，建吐魯番滿城。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, the Turpan Manchu city was built.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, the Turpan Manchu city was built.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙未，以孫士毅為雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day yiwei: Sun Shiyi was made Yunnan governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Sun Shiyi became Yunnan governor.

sentences.zh: 八月戊辰，上幸木蘭行圍。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day wuchen: the Emperor went to Mulan for the autumn hunt.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, the Emperor went to Mulan for the autumn hunt.

sentences.zh: 辛未，命和珅在御前大臣上學習行走。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Heshen was ordered to study while walking attendance among grand ministers before the throne.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Heshen was ordered to study in attendance before the throne.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以宗室永瑋為黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Bannerman Yongwei was made Heilongjiang general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Bannerman Yongwei became Heilongjiang general.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，寧壽宮成。

translations.literal: On day yihai, the Palace of Tranquil Longevity was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, the Palace of Tranquil Longevity was completed.

sentences.zh: 九月庚子，上還京師。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengzi: the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi in the ninth month, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬戌，免陝西延安等三府州屬乾隆二十年至三十七年民欠社倉穀。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day renxu: community-granary grain owed by the people of subordinate units of three Shaanxi prefectures and departments including Yan'an, from Qianlong 20 through 37, was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu in the tenth month, Yan'an and two other Shaanxi districts were forgiven community-granary grain debts from 1735–1772.

sentences.zh: 免西藏那克舒三十九族番子等應交馬銀。

translations.literal: Horse tribute silver due from Tibetan Nakshu thirty-nine tribes and other Fan people was remitted.
