translations.idiomatic: Horse tribute silver for Nakshu's thirty-nine Tibetan tribes was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，免甘肅庄浪等十七廳州縣被災額賦。

translations.literal: On day yihai, quota land tax for seventeen Gansu subprefectures, departments, and counties including Zhuanglang that had suffered disaster was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, disaster taxes were remitted in seventeen Gansu districts including Zhuanglang.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲申，免安徽亳州等十一州縣額賦。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiashen: quota land tax was remitted for eleven Anhui prefectures and counties including Bozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen in the eleventh month, land tax was forgiven in eleven Anhui districts including Bozhou.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，杭州將軍嵩椿坐耽於逸樂褫職，仍通諭申儆。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Hangzhou general Songzhu was stripped of office for indulgence in pleasure, and a circular notice of admonition was still issued.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Hangzhou general Songzhu lost his post for dissipation; a general warning was issued.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，賑甘肅皋蘭等十二廳州縣災民，並蠲本年額賦。

translations.literal: On day guimao, disaster victims in twelve Gansu subprefectures, departments, and counties including Gaolan were relieved, and this year's quota land tax was also remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Gaolan and eleven other Gansu districts received relief and this year's tax was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以姚成烈為廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Yao Chengilie was made Guangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Yao Chengilie became Guangxi governor.

sentences.zh: 以伍彌泰護送班禪至熱河，給欽差大臣關防。

translations.literal: Wumitai was assigned to escort the Panchen to Rehe and was given the imperial commissioner seal.
translations.idiomatic: Wumitai escorted the Panchen to Rehe with commissioner credentials.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸丑，命侍郎德成至河南會辦河工。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guichou: Vice Minister Decheng was ordered to Henan to jointly manage river works.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou in the twelfth month, Vice Minister Decheng was sent to Henan for river works.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，命戶部侍郎董誥在軍機處行走。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Revenue Vice Minister Dong Gao was ordered to serve at the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Dong Gao of Revenue joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，兩廣總督桂林卒，以巴延三代之，雅德為山西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Liangguang governor-general Gui Lin died; Bayaan succeeded him, and Yade became Shanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Gui Lin died; Bayaan took Liangguang and Yade became Shanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 戊午，大學士于敏中卒。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Grand Secretary Yu Minzhong died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Grand Secretary Yu Minzhong died.

sentences.zh: 湖廣總督圖思德卒，以富勒渾代之，綽克托代為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Huguang governor-general Tuside died; Fulehun succeeded him, and Chuoketuo became Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Tuside died; Fulehun took Huguang and Chuoketuo became Works minister.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，賑湖北沔陽等七州縣衛本年水災。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, this year's flood victims in seven Hubei prefectures, counties, and guards including Mianyang were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, flood relief was given in seven Hubei districts including Mianyang.

sentences.zh: 己巳，命程景伊為文淵閣大學士，調嵇璜為吏部尚書、協辦大學士，周煌為工部尚書。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Cheng Jingyi was made Wenyuan Pavilion Grand Secretary; Ji Huang was transferred to Minister of Personnel and Associate Grand Secretary; Zhou Huang was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Cheng Jingyi became Wenyuan grand secretary; Ji Huang joined Personnel and the Grand Secretariat; Zhou Huang took Works.

sentences.zh: 辛未，直隸總督楊景素卒，以袁守侗代之。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Zhili governor-general Yang Jingsu died; Yuan Shoutong succeeded him.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Yang Jingsu died and Yuan Shoutong took Zhili.

sentences.zh: 調陳輝祖為河東河道總督，榮柱為河南巡撫。

translations.literal: Chen Huizu was transferred to be Canal Transport governor-general east of the Yellow River; Rongzhu was made Henan governor.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Huizu became east-of-Huanghe canal commissioner; Rongzhu, Henan governor.

sentences.zh: 四十五年春正月庚辰朔，以八月七旬萬壽，頒詔覃恩有差。

translations.literal: Forty-fifth year, spring, first month, new moon on day gengchen: because the August seventieth-birthday longevity celebration was at hand, an edict was issued granting favors by degree.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the forty-fifth year, on the first-month new moon, Hongli proclaimed graded amnesties ahead of his August seventieth birthday.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，免河南儀封等十三州縣被災額賦。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, quota land tax was remitted for thirteen Henan prefectures and counties including Yifeng that had suffered disaster.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, disaster taxes were forgiven in thirteen Henan districts including Yifeng.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，上巡幸江、浙，免直隸、山東經過地方本年額賦十分之三。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, the Emperor toured Jiangnan and Zhejiang; this year's quota land tax was remitted by three-tenths for districts passed through in Zhili and Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, the Emperor toured Jiang-Zhe and cut transit taxes thirty percent in Zhili and Shandong.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，免直隸順德等四府屬逋賦。

translations.literal: On day renchen, tax arrears were remitted for subordinates of four Zhili prefectures including Shunde.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, back taxes were forgiven in four Zhili prefectures including Shunde.

sentences.zh: 己亥，免山東歷城等二十八州縣逋賦及倉穀。

translations.literal: On day jihai, tax arrears and granary grain owed were remitted for twenty-eight Shandong prefectures and counties including Licheng.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Licheng and twenty-seven other Shandong districts were forgiven arrears and granary debts.

sentences.zh: 己酉，朝鮮國王李算表賀萬壽，優詔答之。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Korean King Yi Suan memorialized congratulations on the longevity celebration; a gracious edict replied.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Korea's king congratulated the longevity celebration and received a warm reply.

sentences.zh: 修浙江仁和、海寧塘工。

translations.literal: Seawall works at Zhejiang's Renhe and Haining were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: Renhe and Haining seawalls in Zhejiang were repaired.

sentences.zh: 二月癸丑，命舒常同和珅、喀寧阿查辦海寧劾李侍堯各款。

translations.literal: Second month, day guichou: Shuchang was ordered together with Heshen and Kaning'a to investigate the various charges in the Haining impeachment of Li Shiyao.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou in the second month, Shuchang, Heshen, and Kaning'a were assigned to probe Li Shiyao's Haining case.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，免江南、浙江經過地方本年額賦十分之三。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, this year's quota land tax was remitted by three-tenths for districts passed through in Jiangnan and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Jiangnan and Zhejiang transit taxes were cut thirty percent.

sentences.zh: 免兩江所屬四十三年以前逋賦。

translations.literal: Tax arrears before the forty-third year among subordinates of the Two Jiangs were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Two Jiangs districts were forgiven taxes owed before year 43.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，調李奉翰為河東河道總督，陳輝祖為江南河道總督。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Li Fenghan was transferred to Canal Transport governor-general east of the Yellow River; Chen Huizu to Jiangnan Canal Transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Li Fenghan took east-of-Huanghe canal duties and Chen Huizu, Jiangnan canal transport.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，免台灣府屬本年額穀，免兩淮灶戶災欠及川餉未繳銀。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, this year's quota grain was remitted for Taiwan prefecture and its subordinates; disaster arrears of salt-furnace households in the Two Huai and unpaid Sichuan tribute silver were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Taiwan grain tax was forgiven and Two Huai and Sichuan tribute debts were cleared.

sentences.zh: 己未，上渡江，閱清口東壩堤工。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, the Emperor crossed the river and inspected the eastern-bank dikes at Qingkou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, the Emperor crossed the Yangzi and inspected Qingkou east-bank dikes.

sentences.zh: 甲子，免江南、浙江省會附郭諸州縣本年額賦。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, this year's quota land tax was remitted for metropolitan satellite prefectures and counties of Jiangnan and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, capital-suburb taxes were forgiven in Jiangnan and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，上幸焦山。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, the Emperor visited Jiaoshan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, the Emperor visited Jiaoshan.

sentences.zh: 壬申，上幸蘇州府。

translations.literal: On day renshen, the Emperor visited Suzhou prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, the Emperor visited Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 儀封決口合龍。

translations.literal: The breach at Yifeng was closed.
translations.idiomatic: The Yifeng river breach was sealed.

sentences.zh: 己卯，免浙江仁和等縣逋賦。

translations.literal: On day jimao, tax arrears were remitted for Zhejiang counties including Renhe.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, back taxes were forgiven in Renhe and other Zhejiang counties.

sentences.zh: 三月辛巳，上幸海寧州觀潮。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinsi: the Emperor visited Haining prefecture to watch the tide.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi in the third month, the Emperor watched the tide at Haining.

sentences.zh: 壬午，上幸尖山。

translations.literal: On day renwu, the Emperor visited Jianshan.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, the Emperor visited Jianshan.

sentences.zh: 召索諾木策凌來京，以奎林為烏魯木齊都統。

translations.literal: Suonuomu Celing was summoned to the capital; Kuilin was made Urumqi commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Suonuomu Celing was called to Beijing; Kuilin became Urumqi commandant.

sentences.zh: 癸未，上幸杭州府。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, the Emperor visited Hangzhou prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, the Emperor visited Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲申，上幸秋濤宮閱水師。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, the Emperor visited Qiutaogong to review the naval forces.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, the Emperor reviewed the fleet at Qiutaogong.

sentences.zh: 以博清額為理藩院尚書。

translations.literal: Boqing'e was made Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Boqing'e became colonial affairs minister.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，調李質穎為浙江巡撫，李湖為廣東巡撫，以劉墉為湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Li Zhiying was transferred to Zhejiang governor; Li Hu to Guangdong governor; Liu Yong was made Hunan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Li Zhiying took Zhejiang, Li Hu Guangdong, and Liu Yong Hunan.

sentences.zh: 以京察屆期，予阿桂等議敘，左都御史崔應階等原品休致。

translations.literal: Because the metropolitan evaluation period had arrived, A Gui and others were rated for merit records; Left Censor-in-Chief Cui Yingjie and others retired at their original ranks.
translations.idiomatic: At evaluation time, A Gui and others received merit ratings; Cui Yingjie and other censors retired at rank.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以羅源漢為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Luo Yuanhan was made Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Luo Yuanhan became left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，李侍堯褫職逮問。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Li Shiyao was stripped of office and arrested for interrogation.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Li Shiyao was dismissed and arrested.

sentences.zh: 孫士毅褫職，發伊犁效力。

translations.literal: Sun Shiyi was stripped of office and sent to serve at Yili.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Shiyi lost his post and was banished to Yili.

sentences.zh: 以福康安為雲貴總督，索諾木策凌為盛京將軍。

translations.literal: Fukang'an was made Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general; Suonuomu Celing was made Shengjing general.
translations.idiomatic: Fukang'an took Yunnan-Guizhou; Suonuomu Celing became Shengjing general.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，命英廉為東閣大學士，和珅為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Yinglian was made Dongge Grand Secretary; Heshen was made Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Yinglian joined the Grand Secretariat and Heshen became revenue minister.

sentences.zh: 丙午，上詣明太祖陵奠酒。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, the Emperor went to the tomb of the Ming founder to offer libations.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, the Emperor offered wine at the Ming founding emperor's tomb.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己酉朔，上渡江。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, new moon on day jiyou: the Emperor crossed the river.
translations.idiomatic: On the fourth-month new moon of jiyou, the Emperor recrossed the Yangzi.

sentences.zh: 壬子，山東壽光人魏塾以著書悖妄，處斬。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Wei Shu of Shouguang, Shandong, was executed for seditious writings in his books.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Shouguang's Wei Shu was beheaded for heretical writings.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，上至武家墩，閱高家堰堤工，渡河。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, the Emperor reached Wujiadun, inspected the Gaojiayan dikes, and crossed the river.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, the Emperor inspected Gaojiayan dikes at Wujiadun and crossed the river.

sentences.zh: 免山西太原等十六府州並歸化城等廳應徵額賦十分之三，大同、朔平及和林格爾等屬全免之。

translations.literal: Quota land tax levied was remitted by three-tenths for sixteen Shanxi prefectures and departments including Taiyuan and subprefectures including Guihua walled city; Datong, Shuoping, and subordinates including Horinger were wholly remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Shanxi taxes were cut thirty percent in sixteen districts; Datong, Shuoping, and Horinger were fully forgiven.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，調楊魁為陝西巡撫，劉秉恬署雲南巡撫，顏希深為貴州巡撫，吳壇為江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Yang Kui was transferred to Shaanxi governor; Liu Bingtian acted as Yunnan governor; Yan Xishen was made Guizhou governor; Wu Tan was made Jiangsu governor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Yang Kui took Shaanxi, Liu Bingtian acted in Yunnan, Yan Xishen Guizhou, and Wu Tan Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，調楊魁為河南巡撫，雅德為陝西巡撫，喀寧阿為山西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Yang Kui was transferred to Henan governor; Yade to Shaanxi governor; Kaning'a to Shanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Yang Kui took Henan, Yade Shaanxi, and Kaning'a Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 五月甲申，以大學士、九卿改和珅所擬李侍堯監候為斬決，諭各督撫各抒所見，定擬題奏。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiashen: the Grand Secretariat and Nine Ministries changed Heshen's proposed sentence of imprisonment awaiting execution for Li Shiyao to immediate decapitation, instructing each governor-general and governor to state his view and memorialize a fixed recommendation.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, ministers upgraded Li Shiyao from suspended death to beheading over Heshen's draft and ordered governors to report their views.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，賜汪如洋等一百五十五人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Wang Ruyang and one hundred fifty-five others were granted jinshi degrees with differences in rank.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Wang Ruyang and 155 others received jinshi with graded ranks.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，宥孫士毅罪。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Sun Shiyi's crime was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Sun Shiyi was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 己亥，上秋獮木蘭。

translations.literal: On day jihai, the Emperor went autumn hunting at Mulan.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, the Emperor hunted at Mulan.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，上駐蹕避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day yisi, the Emperor halted at the Mountain Resort for Avoiding Summer Heat.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, the Emperor stayed at the Summer Resort.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，免湖北沔陽等五州縣本年水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, this year's flood quota land tax was remitted for five Hubei prefectures and counties including Mianyang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, flood taxes were forgiven in five Hubei districts including Mianyang.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，召大學士三寶入閣辦事。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Grand Secretary Sanbao was summoned into the Grand Secretariat to handle affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Grand Secretary Sanbao entered the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 調富勒渾為閩浙總督，舒常為湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Fulehun was transferred to Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general; Shuchang to Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Fulehun took Fujian-Zhejiang; Shuchang, Huguang.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以和珅為正白旗領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Heshen was made inner grandee and chief guard of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Heshen became Plain White chief guard and inner grandee.

sentences.zh: 庚午，江蘇睢寧郭家渡河決。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, the Guojiadu crossing on the Sui River in Suining, Jiangsu, broke.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, the Guojiadu breach opened on Jiangsu's Sui River at Suining.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁丑，起孫士毅為編修。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day dingchou: Sun Shiyi was recalled to serve as compiler in the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Sun Shiyi was restored as Hanlin compiler.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，班禪額爾德尼自後藏入覲，上御清曠殿，賜坐，賜茶。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, the Panchen Erdeni came from rear Tibet to audience; the Emperor received him at the Qinghuang Hall, granted a seat, and granted tea.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, the Panchen arrived from Tibet; Hongli received him at Qinghuang Hall with seat and tea.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，順天良鄉永定河決。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, the Yongding River broke at Liangxiang in Shuntian.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, the Yongding River breached at Liangxiang.

sentences.zh: 庚子，上御萬樹園，賜班禪額爾德尼及王、公、大臣，蒙古王、貝勒、貝子、公、額駙、台吉等宴，並賜冠服金幣有差。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, at the Garden of Ten Thousand Trees the Emperor gave a banquet to the Panchen Erdeni, princes, dukes, ministers, Mongol princes, beile, beizi, dukes, imperial sons-in-law, taiji, and others, and granted caps, robes, gold, and coins with differences.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, at Wanshuyuan the court banqueted the Panchen and Mongol nobles and gave graded gifts.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，山東曹縣及河南考城河決。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, rivers broke at Caoxian in Shandong and Kaocheng in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, rivers breached at Shandong's Caoxian and Henan's Kaocheng.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以李本為貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Li Ben was made Guizhou governor.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Li Ben became Guizhou governor.

sentences.zh: 八月戊申，賑河南寧陵等四縣水災。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day wushen: flood victims in four Henan counties including Ningling were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen in the eighth month, flood relief went to four Henan counties including Ningling.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，大學士程景伊卒。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Grand Secretary Cheng Jingyi died.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Grand Secretary Cheng Jingyi died.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，永定河決口合龍。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, the Yongding River breach was closed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, the Yongding breach was sealed.

sentences.zh: 湖北巡撫鄭大進貢金器，不納，切責之。

translations.literal: Hubei governor Zheng Dajin presented gold vessels as tribute; they were not accepted and he was sternly rebuked.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Dajin of Hubei offered gold tribute; the court refused and rebuked him sharply.

sentences.zh: 己未，上七旬萬壽節，御澹泊敬誠殿，王、公、大臣及蒙古王、貝勒、貝子、額駙、台吉等行慶賀禮。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, on the seventieth-birthday longevity festival the Emperor received congratulations at the Hall of Simple Sincerity from princes, dukes, ministers, and Mongol princes, beile, beizi, imperial sons-in-law, and taiji.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Hongli's seventieth birthday was celebrated at Danbojingcheng Hall by princes, officials, and Mongol nobles.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，調閔鶚元為江蘇巡撫，農起為安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Min E'yuan was transferred to Jiangsu governor; Nong Qi to Anhui governor.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Min E'yuan took Jiangsu and Nong Qi Anhui.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，上詣東西陵，免經過地方本年額賦十分之三。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, the Emperor went to the Eastern and Western Tombs; this year's quota land tax was remitted by three-tenths for districts passed through.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, the Emperor visited the tombs and cut transit taxes thirty percent.

sentences.zh: 賑浙江諸暨等七縣水災。

translations.literal: Flood victims in seven Zhejiang counties including Zhuji were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Flood relief was given in seven Zhejiang counties including Zhuji.

sentences.zh: 九月，以嵇璜為文淵閣大學士，蔡新為吏部尚書、協辦大學士。

translations.literal: Ninth month: Ji Huang was made Wenyuan Pavilion Grand Secretary; Cai Xin was made Minister of Personnel and Associate Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Ji Huang became Wenyuan grand secretary; Cai Xin joined Personnel and the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 調周煌為兵部尚書，以周元理為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Zhou Huang was transferred to Minister of War; Zhou Yuanli was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Huang took War; Zhou Yuanli, Works.

sentences.zh: 壬午，上謁昭西陵、孝陵、孝東陵、景陵，詣孝賢皇后陵奠酒。

translations.literal: On day renwu, the Emperor visited Zhaoxi, Xiao, Xiaodong, and Jing tombs and went to Empress Xiaoxian's tomb to offer libations.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, the Emperor paid at several tombs and offered wine at Empress Xiaoxian's mound.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，上謁泰陵、泰東陵。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, the Emperor visited Tai and Taidong tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, the Emperor visited Tai and Taidong tombs.

sentences.zh: 睢寧郭家渡決口合龍。

translations.literal: The Guojiadu breach at Suining was closed.
translations.idiomatic: The Suining Guojiadu breach was sealed.

sentences.zh: 乙未，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，賑吉林琿春水災。

translations.literal: On day yisi, spring flood victims in Jilin's Hunchun were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Hunchun flood victims in Jilin received relief.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊申，定李侍堯斬監候。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wushen: Li Shiyao was sentenced to decapitation with imprisonment awaiting execution.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen in the tenth month, Li Shiyao received the death sentence suspended by imprisonment.

sentences.zh: 調雅德為河南巡撫。

translations.literal: Yade was transferred to Henan governor.
translations.idiomatic: Yade became Henan governor.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，免河南儀封等六縣本年水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, this year's flood quota land tax was remitted for six Henan counties including Yifeng.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, flood taxes were forgiven in six Henan counties including Yifeng.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，免直隸霸州等六十三州縣本年水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day renxu, this year's flood quota land tax was remitted for sixty-three Zhili prefectures and counties including Bazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, flood taxes were forgiven in sixty-three Zhili districts including Bazhou.

sentences.zh: 免江蘇清河等八州縣衛本年水旱額賦。

translations.literal: This year's flood-and-drought quota land tax was remitted for eight Jiangsu prefectures, counties, and guards including Qinghe.
translations.idiomatic: Flood and drought taxes were forgiven in eight Jiangsu districts including Qinghe.

sentences.zh: 免甘肅皋蘭等三十五廳州縣四十四年水災額賦。

translations.literal: Quota land tax for the forty-fourth year's flood was remitted for thirty-five Gansu subprefectures, departments, and counties including Gaolan.
translations.idiomatic: Forty-fourth-year flood taxes were forgiven in thirty-five Gansu districts including Gaolan.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，命博清額署左都御史，和珅仍兼署理藩院尚書。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Boqing'e was ordered to act as Left Censor-in-Chief; Heshen still concurrently acted as Minister of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Boqing'e acted as left censor-in-chief and Heshen kept colonial affairs.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚辰，命博清額為欽差大臣，護送班禪額爾德尼往穆魯烏蘇地方。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day gengchen: Boqing'e was made imperial commissioner to escort the Panchen Erdeni to the Muru Usu region.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen in the eleventh month, Boqing'e escorted the Panchen to Muru Usu as commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以慶桂為烏里雅蘇台將軍。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Qinggui was made general at Uliastai.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Qinggui became Uliastai general.

sentences.zh: 癸未，班禪額爾德尼卒於京師。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, the Panchen Erdeni died in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, the Panchen died in Beijing.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙卯，賑甘肅皋蘭等十八廳州縣飢民。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day yimao: famine victims in eighteen Gansu subprefectures, departments, and counties including Gaolan were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao in the twelfth month, eighteen Gansu districts including Gaolan received famine relief.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以會同四譯館屋壞，壓斃朝鮮人，禮部尚書等下部嚴議。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, because a building of the Joint Four Translation Office collapsed and crushed Koreans to death, the Minister of Rites and others were referred to the boards for stern deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, the ritual minister and others faced strict review after the Four Translation Office collapse killed Koreans.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，命阿桂會同陳輝祖、富勒渾、李質穎勘視海塘。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Agui was ordered to join Chen Huizu, Fu Heng, and Li Zhiying in inspecting the sea dikes.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Agui, Chen Huizu, Fu Heng, and Li Zhiying were sent to inspect the sea dikes.

sentences.zh: 四十六年春正月己卯，定蒙古喀爾喀，青海杜爾伯特、土爾扈特、和碩特，回部王、公、札薩克、台吉等世襲爵秩。

translations.literal: Forty-sixth year, spring, first month, day jimao: hereditary noble ranks were fixed for Khalkha Mongols, Qinghai Dorbod, Torghut, and Khoshut, and for Muslim-area princes, dukes, jasaq, and taiji.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year 46, jimao, hereditary ranks were set for frontier Mongol and Muslim nobles.

sentences.zh: 丙申，朝鮮國王李算表謝賜緞匹，仍貢方物，溫諭受之。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Korean King Yi Suan memorialized thanks for gifted silks and still sent tribute goods; a warm edict accepted them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, King Yi Suan of Korea thanked the court for silks, sent tribute, and was warmly told to accept.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，召富勒渾、李質穎來京。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Fu Heng and Li Zhiying were summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Fu Heng and Li Zhiying were recalled to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 以陳輝祖為閩浙總督，兼管浙江巡撫，督辦塘工。

translations.literal: Chen Huizu was made Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general, concurrently directing Zhejiang governor affairs and supervising dike works.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Huizu became Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general, took Zhejiang, and oversaw the dikes.

sentences.zh: 調李奉翰為江南河道總督，韓鑅為河東河道總督。

translations.literal: Li Fenghan was transferred to Jiangnan Canal director-general and Han Hong to Hedong Canal director-general.
translations.idiomatic: Li Fenghan took Jiangnan canal command and Han Hong Hedong canal command.

sentences.zh: 二月丙辰，免浙江諸暨水災額賦。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingchen: quota tax was remitted for Zhuji, Zhejiang, for flood damage.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, bingchen, Zhuji lost flood quota tax.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，命阿桂勘視江南、河南河工。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Agui was ordered to inspect river works in Jiangnan and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Agui was sent to inspect Jiangnan and Henan rivers.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，上西巡五台山，免經過地方本年額賦十分之三。

translations.literal: On day yichou, the Emperor toured west to Wutai Mountain and remitted three-tenths of this year's quota tax in passed areas.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, the Emperor went to Wutai Mountain and cut three-tenths of quota tax along the route.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，免順天保定七府州縣逋賦。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, arrears tax was remitted for seven prefectures and counties in Shuntian and Baoding.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Shuntian and Baoding forgave tax arrears in seven districts.

sentences.zh: 己巳，調雅德為山西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Yade was transferred to Shanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Yade became Shanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以富勒渾為河南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Fu Heng was made Henan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Fu Heng became Henan governor.

sentences.zh: 王燧論絞。

translations.literal: Wang Sui was sentenced to strangulation.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Sui was sentenced to strangulation.

sentences.zh: 三月甲戌朔，上幸正定府閱兵。

translations.literal: Third month, new moon on day jiaxu: the Emperor visited Zhengding prefecture to review troops.
translations.idiomatic: On the third-month new moon, jiaxu, the Emperor reviewed troops at Zhengding.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，免安徽亳州等九州縣、鳳陽等三衛水災額賦有差。

translations.literal: On day yihai, quota tax was remitted in differing amounts for flood damage in nine Bozhou-area counties of Anhui and three guards including Fengyang.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Anhui and Fengyang-area flood taxes were forgiven in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 丙子，免江蘇清河等八州縣衛水災額賦有差。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, quota tax was remitted in differing amounts for flood damage in eight Jiangsu prefectures, counties, and guards including Qinghe.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, eight Jiangsu districts including Qinghe lost graded flood quota tax.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，召慶桂來京，以巴圖署烏里雅蘇台將軍。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Qing Gui was summoned to the capital and Batu acted as Uliastai general.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Qing Gui was recalled and Batu acted at Uliastai.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，上駐蹕五台山。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, the Emperor halted at Wutai Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, the court halted at Wutai Mountain.

sentences.zh: 己丑，免甘肅皋蘭等十五廳州縣雹災額賦有差。

translations.literal: On day jichou, quota tax was remitted in differing amounts for hail damage in fifteen Gansu prefectures and counties including Gaolan.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, fifteen Gansu districts including Gaolan lost graded hail quota tax.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以宗室嵩椿為綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, imperial clansman Songchun was made Suiyuan City general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Songchun became Suiyuan City general.

sentences.zh: 庚子，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，甘肅循化廳撒拉爾回匪蘇四十三等作亂，陷河州，命西安提督馬彪同勒爾謹剿之。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Salar Muslim rebels led by Su Forty-three and others at Xunhua subprefecture, Gansu, rose and seized Hezhou; Xi'an provincial military commander Ma Biao was ordered to join Le'erjin in suppressing them.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Su Forty-three's Salar rebels seized Hezhou and Ma Biao joined Le'erjin to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，回匪犯蘭州，命阿桂往甘肅調度剿賊機宜。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Muslim rebels attacked Lanzhou; Agui was ordered to Gansu to direct anti-rebel operations.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, rebels hit Lanzhou and Agui was sent to direct Gansu operations.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲申朔，命尚書和珅、額駙拉旺多爾濟、領侍衛內大臣海蘭察，並巴圖魯侍衛等，赴甘肅剿賊。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, new moon on day jiashen: Minister Heshen, imperial son-in-law Lawangduo'erji, chief bodyguard minister Hailancha, and Brave Guards were ordered to Gansu to suppress rebels.
translations.idiomatic: On the fourth-month new moon, jiashen, Heshen, Lawangduo'erji, Hailancha, and Brave Guards were sent to Gansu.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，命安徽巡撫農起往甘肅辦理軍需，宥李侍堯罪，賞三品頂戴赴甘肅。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Anhui governor Nong Qi was ordered to Gansu for military supply; Li Shiyao's crimes were pardoned and he was granted third-rank hat insignia to go to Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Nong Qi went to Gansu for supplies and Li Shiyao was pardoned with third-rank insignia.

sentences.zh: 己酉，甘肅官軍收復河州，仁和進援省城。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Gansu government troops recovered Hezhou and Renhe advanced to relieve the provincial capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Hezhou was recovered and Renhe advanced to relieve Lanzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚申，休致大理寺卿尹嘉銓坐妄請其父從祀孔廟及著書狂悖，處絞。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, retired Court of Appeals president Yin Jiaquan, for vainly asking his father's enshrinement in the Confucian temple and for seditious writings, was sentenced to strangulation.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Yin Jiaquan was sentenced to strangulation for temple enshrinement pleas and seditious books.

sentences.zh: 免直隸霸州等五十廳州縣水災額賦。

translations.literal: Quota tax was remitted for flood damage in fifty Zhili prefectures and counties including Bazhou.
translations.idiomatic: Flood quota tax was forgiven in fifty Zhili districts including Bazhou.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，賜錢棨等一百六十九人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Qian Qi and one hundred sixty-nine others received jinshi degrees and postings in differing grades.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Qian Qi and 169 others received jinshi ranks in graded postings.

sentences.zh: 庚午，逮勒爾謹，以李侍堯管理陝甘總督事，未至，以阿桂兼管之。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Le'erjin was arrested; Li Shiyao was ordered to manage Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general affairs; before he arrived, Agui acted concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Le'erjin was arrested; Li Shiyao was named to Shaanxi-Gansu and Agui acted until he came.

sentences.zh: 召和珅回京。

translations.literal: Heshen was recalled to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Heshen was recalled to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 辛未，免安徽壽州等十二州縣衛、河南儀封等五縣水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, quota tax was remitted for flood damage in twelve Anhui prefectures, counties, and guards including Shouzhou and five Henan counties including Yifeng.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, flood quota tax was forgiven in twelve Anhui districts and five Henan counties including Yifeng.

sentences.zh: 五月辛卯，諭阿桂等除回民新教。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinmao: Agui and others were instructed to eliminate the Muslim New Teaching sect.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, xinmao, Agui was told to eliminate the Muslim New Teaching.

sentences.zh: 閏五月癸卯朔，勒爾謹論斬。

translations.literal: Intercalary fifth month, new moon on day guimao: Le'erjin was sentenced to decapitation.
translations.idiomatic: On the intercalary fifth-month new moon, guimao, Le'erjin was sentenced to decapitation.

sentences.zh: 己酉，免江蘇阜寧等七縣衛逋賦。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, arrears tax was remitted for seven Jiangsu counties and guards including Funing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Funing and six other Jiangsu districts lost tax arrears.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，上秋獮木蘭。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, the Emperor went to Mulan for the autumn battue.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, the Emperor went to Mulan for the autumn hunt.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，上駐蹕避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, the Emperor halted at the Mountain Resort.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, the court halted at the Summer Resort.

sentences.zh: 六月庚辰，江蘇睢寧魏家莊河決。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengchen: the Yellow River breached at Weijiazhuang, Suining, Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, gengchen, the Yellow River broke at Weijiazhuang in Suining.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以甘肅累年冒賑，命刑部嚴鞫勒爾謹，逮王亶望至都。

translations.literal: On day jichou, because of years of fraudulent relief in Gansu, the Ministry of Punishments was ordered to interrogate Le'erjin strictly and Wang Danwang was brought to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Gansu relief fraud led to strict interrogation of Le'erjin and Wang Danwang's arrest.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，免陝西西安等十二府州民欠倉穀。

translations.literal: On day renchen, granary grain debts were remitted for twelve Shaanxi prefectures and departments including Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, twelve Shaanxi districts including Xi'an lost granary grain debts.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，甘肅回匪蘇四十三等伏誅。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Gansu Muslim rebels Su Forty-three and others were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Su Forty-three and other Gansu rebels were executed.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬寅朔，江蘇崇明、太倉等州縣海溢。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, new moon on day renyin: sea overflow inundated Chongming, Taicang, and other Jiangsu prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On the seventh-month new moon, renyin, sea floods hit Chongming, Taicang, and other Jiangsu districts.

sentences.zh: 甘肅布政使王廷贊，以冒賑浮銷，褫職逮治。

translations.literal: Gansu provincial treasurer Wang Tingzan was stripped of office and arrested for fraudulent relief and inflated expenditures.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Tingzan lost his Gansu treasurer post for relief fraud and inflated spending.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以奎林為烏里雅蘇台將軍，明亮為烏魯木齊都統。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Kuilin was made Uliastai general and Mingliang Urumqi military governor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Kuilin became Uliastai general and Mingliang Urumqi governor.

sentences.zh: 己酉，河南萬錦灘及儀封曲家樓河決。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, the Yellow River breached at Wanjin Tan in Henan and Qujialou at Yifeng.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, the river broke at Wanjin Tan and Qujialou in Henan.

sentences.zh: 庚申，暹羅國長鄭昭遣使齎表貢方物。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Siam's leader Zheng Zhao sent envoys bearing memorial and tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Zheng Zhao of Siam sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，命阿桂閱視河南、山東河工。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Agui was ordered to inspect river works in Henan and Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Agui was sent to inspect Henan and Shandong rivers.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，南掌國王弟召翁貢方物。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Prince Zhao Weng of Lan Xang presented tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Zhao Weng of Lan Xang presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚午，王亶望處斬，賜勒爾謹自盡，王廷贊論絞。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Wang Danwang was beheaded; Le'erjin was granted suicide; Wang Tingzan was sentenced to strangulation.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Wang Danwang was beheaded, Le'erjin granted suicide, and Wang Tingzan sentenced to strangulation.

sentences.zh: 免江蘇崇明縣本年額賦。

translations.literal: This year's quota tax was remitted for Chongming County, Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Chongming County lost this year's quota tax.

sentences.zh: 賑江蘇崇明等九廳州縣、河南儀封縣水災。

translations.literal: Relief was given for floods in nine Jiangsu prefectures and counties including Chongming and Yifeng County in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Floods in nine Jiangsu districts and Yifeng, Henan, received relief.

sentences.zh: 八月甲戌，賑甘肅隴西等四縣水災。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiaxu: relief was given for floods in four Gansu counties including Longxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, jiaxu, four Gansu counties including Longxi received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 免金縣等七縣額徵半賦。

translations.literal: Half the levied quota was remitted for seven counties including Jinxian.
translations.idiomatic: Seven counties including Jinxian lost half their levied quota.

sentences.zh: 己卯，袁守侗等坐查監糧失實，下部嚴議。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Yuan Shoutong and others, for an inaccurate grain-inspection inquiry, were referred to the ministries for strict deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Yuan Shoutong and others faced strict ministry review for a false grain inquiry.

sentences.zh: 壬午，調福康安為四川總督，以富綱為雲貴總督，楊魁署福建巡撫。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Fukang'an was transferred to Sichuan governor-general; Fu Gang was made Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general; Yang Kui acted as Fujian governor.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Fukang'an took Sichuan, Fu Gang Yunnan-Guizhou, and Yang Kui acted in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，賑湖北潛江等四州縣水災。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, relief was given for floods in four Hubei prefectures and counties including Qianjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, four Hubei districts including Qianjiang received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，上幸木蘭行圍。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, the Emperor went to Mulan for the hunt encampment.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, the Emperor went to Mulan for the hunt.

sentences.zh: 魏家莊決口合龍。

translations.literal: The Weijiazhuang breach was closed.
translations.idiomatic: The Weijiazhuang breach was closed.

sentences.zh: 九月戊申，王廷贊處絞。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wushen: Wang Tingzan was executed by strangulation.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, wushen, Wang Tingzan was executed by strangulation.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，賑山東金鄉水災。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, relief was given for floods in Jinxiang, Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Jinxiang, Shandong, received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙子，賑江蘇銅山等縣水災。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingzi: relief was given for floods in Tongshan and other Jiangsu counties.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, bingzi, Tongshan and other Jiangsu counties received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，賑山東鄒平等二十九州縣、濟寧等三衛、永阜等三場水災。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, relief was given for floods in twenty-nine Shandong counties including Zouping, three guards including Jining, and three saltern areas including Yongfu.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, floods in twenty-nine Shandong counties, three guards, and three salterns received relief.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，賑直隸滄州等四州縣、嚴鎮等四場水災。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, relief was given for floods in four Zhili prefectures and counties including Cangzhou and four saltern areas including Yanzhen.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Cangzhou and three other Zhili districts and four salterns received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 戊子，賑河南祥符十三縣水災。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, relief was given for floods in thirteen Henan counties including Xiangfu.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, thirteen Henan counties including Xiangfu received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，賑湖北江夏等十七州縣水旱災。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, relief was given for flood and drought in seventeen Hubei prefectures and counties including Jiangxia.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, seventeen Hubei districts including Jiangxia received flood and drought relief.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，賑安徽靈壁等二十四州縣衛水旱災。

translations.literal: On day guisi, relief was given for flood and drought in twenty-four Anhui prefectures, counties, and guards including Lingbi.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, twenty-four Anhui districts including Lingbi received flood and drought relief.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，上以御史劉天成奏，諭曰：「均田之法，勢必致貧者未富，富者先貧。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, citing censor Liu Tiancheng's memorial, the Emperor instructed: "The method of equalizing land would surely leave the poor not yet rich while the rich became poor first.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, citing Liu Tiancheng, the Emperor said equalizing land would impoverish the rich before enriching the poor.

sentences.zh: 我君臣惟崇儉尚朴，知愧知懼，使四民則效而已。

translations.literal: We ruler and ministers should only esteem frugality and plain living, know shame and fear, and let the four classes model themselves on this alone.
translations.idiomatic: He said ruler and ministers should practice frugality and shame so the four classes would follow.

sentences.zh: 」罷陝西貢皮。

translations.literal: " Tribute fur from Shaanxi was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi fur tribute was abolished.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚子，工部尚書周元理予告，以羅源漢代之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day gengzi: Minister of Works Zhou Yuanli retired on leave and Luo Yuanhan replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, gengzi, Zhou Yuanli retired and Luo Yuanhan replaced him at Works.

sentences.zh: 以劉墉為左都御史，仍暫管湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: Liu Yong was made Left Censor-in-chief while still temporarily directing Hunan governor affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yong became Left Censor-in-chief while still acting Hunan governor.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以李世傑為湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Li Shijie was made Hunan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Li Shijie became Hunan governor.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以鄭大進為直隸總督。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Zheng Dajin was made Zhili governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Zheng Dajin became Zhili governor-general.

sentences.zh: 十二月己巳朔，調姚成烈為湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, new moon on day jisi: Yao Cheng Lie was transferred to Hubei governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the twelfth-month new moon, jisi, Yao Cheng Lie became Hubei governor.

sentences.zh: 以朱椿為廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: Zhu Chun was made Guangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Chun became Guangxi governor.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以雅德為廣東巡撫，譚尚忠為山西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Yade was made Guangdong governor and Tan Shangzhong Shanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Yade took Guangdong and Tan Shangzhong Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 戊子，大學士等議駁嵇璜請復黃河故道，上韙之。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, grand secretaries deliberated and rejected Ji Huang's request to restore the old Yellow River course; the Emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, the court rejected Ji Huang's plan to restore the old Yellow River course and the Emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，畢沅以御史錢灃劾，降三品頂戴留任。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Bi Yuan, impeached by censor Qian Feng, was demoted to third-rank hat insignia but kept in office.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Qian Feng's impeachment demoted Bi Yuan to third-rank insignia but left him in post.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，調農起為山西巡撫，譚尚忠為安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Nong Qi was transferred to Shanxi governor and Tan Shangzhong to Anhui governor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Nong Qi took Shanxi and Tan Shangzhong Anhui.

sentences.zh: 四十七年春正月庚子，陳輝祖、閔鶚元降三品頂戴留任。

translations.literal: Forty-seventh year, spring, first month, day gengzi: Chen Huizu and Min E'yuan were demoted to third-rank hat insignia but kept in office.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year 47, gengzi, Chen Huizu and Min E'yuan were demoted to third-rank insignia but kept their posts.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，建盛京文溯閣。

translations.literal: On day yimao, the Wensu Pavilion was built at Mukden.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Mukden's Wensu Pavilion was built.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，四庫全書成。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, the Complete Library in Four Treasuries was finished.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, the Complete Library in Four Treasuries was finished.

sentences.zh: 二月己巳，上御文淵閣，賜四庫全書總裁等官宴，賞賚有差。

translations.literal: Second month, day jisi: the Emperor attended at the Wenyuan Pavilion and granted a banquet to the chief compilers of the Complete Library in Four Treasuries with rewards in differing grades.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, jisi, the Emperor banqueted the Four Treasuries compilers at Wenyuan with graded rewards.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，命乾清門侍衛阿彌達致祭河神。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Qianqing Gate guard Amida was ordered to offer sacrifice to the river god.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, guard Amida was sent to sacrifice to the river god.

sentences.zh: 三月庚子，上幸盤山。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengzi: the Emperor visited Pan Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, gengzi, the Emperor visited Pan Mountain.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，上駐蹕盤山。

translations.literal: On day renyin, the Emperor halted at Pan Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, the court halted at Pan Mountain.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，調雅德為福建巡撫，以尚安為廣東巡撫。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Yade was transferred to Fujian governor and Shang'an made Guangdong governor.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Yade took Fujian and Shang'an Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，免甘肅積年逋賦糧二百四十五萬石、銀三十萬兩各有奇。

translations.literal: On day yimao, accumulated Gansu tax arrears of two million four hundred fifty thousand piculs of grain and over three hundred thousand taels of silver were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Gansu lost 2.45 million piculs and over 300,000 taels in accumulated arrears.

sentences.zh: 戊午，免江蘇常熟等二十八廳州縣衛水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, quota tax was remitted for flood damage in twenty-eight Jiangsu prefectures, counties, and guards including Changshu.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, twenty-eight Jiangsu districts including Changshu lost flood quota tax.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，免直隸天津等三十九州縣廳水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day guihai, quota tax was remitted for flood damage in thirty-nine Zhili prefectures and counties including Tianjin.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, thirty-nine Zhili districts including Tianjin lost flood quota tax.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊辰，命和珅、劉墉同御史錢灃查辦山東虧空。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wuchen: Heshen, Liu Yong, and censor Qian Feng were ordered to investigate Shandong fiscal deficits.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, wuchen, Heshen, Liu Yong, and Qian Feng were sent to investigate Shandong deficits.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，免山東壽光等五縣水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, quota tax was remitted for flood damage in five Shandong counties including Shouguang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, five Shandong counties including Shouguang lost flood quota tax.

sentences.zh: 己卯，山東巡撫國泰褫職逮問，以明興代之。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Shandong governor Guotai was stripped of office and arrested; Ming Xing replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Guotai was arrested as Shandong governor and Ming Xing replaced him.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，上閱火器營兵。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, the Emperor reviewed Firearms Battalion troops.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, the Emperor reviewed Firearms Battalion troops.

sentences.zh: 甲申，免山西永濟縣水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, quota tax was remitted for flood damage in Yongji County, Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Yongji County, Shanxi, lost flood quota tax.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，上閱健銳營兵。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, the Emperor reviewed Vanguard Camp troops.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, the Emperor reviewed Vanguard Camp troops.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，協辦大學士、吏部尚書蔡新乞假，允之。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Associate Grand Secretary and Minister of Personnel Cai Xin asked leave and was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Cai Xin asked leave as associate grand secretary and personnel minister and was allowed.

sentences.zh: 以劉墉署吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Liu Yong acted as Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yong acted as Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 甲午，羅源漢罷，以劉墉為工部尚書，王傑為都察院左都御史，慶桂為盛京將軍。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Luo Yuanhan was dismissed; Liu Yong was made Minister of Works, Wang Jie Left Censor-in-chief of the Censorate, and Qing Gui Shengjing general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Luo Yuanhan was dismissed; Liu Yong took Works, Wang Jie the Censorate, and Qing Gui Shengjing.

sentences.zh: 五月丁酉，召阿桂來京，命韓鑅、富勒渾籌辦河工。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day dingyou: Agui was summoned to the capital; Han Cheng and Fulehun were ordered to plan river works.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Agui was recalled to Beijing and Han Cheng and Fulehun took charge of the river project.

sentences.zh: 己亥，賑山東曹州、兗州、濟寧等府州，江蘇徐州、豐、沛等縣水災。

translations.literal: On day jihai, relief was given for flood disaster in Shandong prefectures including Caozhou, Yanzhou, and Jining, and in Jiangsu counties including Xuzhou, Feng, and Pei.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, flood relief reached Shandong and Jiangsu districts including Caozhou and Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，免河南祥符等六縣水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, quota land tax was remitted for six Henan counties including Xiangfu stricken by flood.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, flood-struck Henan counties including Xiangfu were exempted from quota tax.

sentences.zh: 定新建巴爾噶遜城名曰嘉德。

translations.literal: The newly built city at Balkhash was named Jiade.
translations.idiomatic: The new Balkhash city was named Jiade.

sentences.zh: 戊申，上幸木蘭。

translations.literal: On day wushen, the Emperor proceeded to Mulan.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, the Emperor went to Mulan.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，免安徽懷寧等十八州縣、安慶等五衛水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, quota land tax was remitted for eighteen Anhui prefectures and counties including Huaining and five guards including Anqing stricken by flood.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, flood quota tax was remitted in eighteen Anhui districts and five Anqing guards.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，上駐蹕避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the Emperor halted at the Mountain Resort for Summer Retreat.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, the Emperor stayed at the Summer Resort.

sentences.zh: 六月丙子，國泰、於易簡論斬。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingzi: Guotai and Yu Yijian were sentenced to death by decapitation.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Guotai and Yu Yijian were sentenced to decapitation.

sentences.zh: 以富躬為安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: Fu Gong was made Anhui governor.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Gong became governor of Anhui.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙申朔，命阿桂仍督辦河工。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, new moon on day bingchen: Agui was again ordered to supervise river works.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Agui was reappointed to supervise the river project.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，索諾木策凌論斬。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Sonombu Celeng was sentenced to death by decapitation.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Sonombu Celeng was sentenced to decapitation.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，國泰、於易簡賜自盡。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Guotai and Yu Yijian were granted suicide.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Guotai and Yu Yijian were allowed to take their own lives.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以李侍堯、國泰所辦貢物過優，皆致罪戾，諭各督撫等惟當潔清自矢，毋專以進獻為能。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, because tribute goods arranged by Li Shiyao and Guotai had been excessive, both incurred guilt; governors and others were instructed only to keep themselves pure and not make presenting tribute their special talent.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Li Shiyao and Guotai were punished for lavish tribute gifts and officials were told to stay honest rather than compete in presents.

sentences.zh: 己未，以何裕城署河東河道總督。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, He Yucheng was made acting Grand Canal governor-general east of the river.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, He Yucheng acted as eastern Grand Canal governor-general.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，免甘肅隴西等四縣四十六年水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day guihai, forty-six years of quota land tax was remitted for four Gansu counties including Longxi stricken by flood.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, forty-six years of flood tax was remitted in four Longxi-area counties.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯，以福康安為御前大臣。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dingmao: Fukang'an was made an imperial presence minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Fukang'an became an imperial presence minister.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以宗室永瑋為吉林將軍，宗室恆秀為黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Imperial clansman Yongwei was made Jilin general; Imperial clansman Hengxiu was made Heilongjiang general.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Yongwei became Jilin general and Hengxiu Heilongjiang general.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，加英廉、嵇璜、和珅、李侍堯、福康安太子太保，梁國治、鄭大進太子少傅，薩載太子少保。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Yinglian, Ji Huang, Heshen, Li Shiyao, and Fukang'an were advanced to Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent; Liang Guozhi and Zheng Dajin to Junior Guardian; Sa Zai to Lesser Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, five ministers received Senior Guardian ranks and Liang, Zheng, and Sa received junior guardian titles.

sentences.zh: 壬午，賑江蘇沛縣等州縣，山東鄒、嶧二縣被水災民。

translations.literal: On day renwu, relief was given for flood victims in Jiangsu prefectures and counties including Peixian and in Shandong counties Zou and Yi.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, flood relief reached Peixian in Jiangsu and Zou and Yi in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 癸未，上幸木蘭行圍。

translations.literal: On day guimei, the Emperor proceeded to Mulan for the hunting encampment.
translations.idiomatic: On guimei day, the Emperor went to Mulan for the autumn hunt.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，賜索諾木策凌自盡。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Sonombu Celeng was granted suicide.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Sonombu Celeng was allowed to kill himself.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，賑山東兗州等府縣被水災民。

translations.literal: On day renchen, relief was given for flood victims in Shandong prefectures and counties including Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Shandong flood victims including Yanzhou received relief.

sentences.zh: 九月丙申，建浙江文瀾閣。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingchen: Zhejiang Wenlan Pavilion was built.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, the Zhejiang Wenlan Pavilion was built.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，上回駐避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day renyin, the Emperor returned and halted at the Mountain Resort for Summer Retreat.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, the Emperor returned to the Summer Resort.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，刑部尚書德福卒，以喀寧阿代之。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Minister of Justice Defu died; Kaning'a replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Defu, minister of justice, died and Kaning'a succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 命英廉暫管刑部。

translations.literal: Yinglian was ordered temporarily to oversee the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: Yinglian was placed in charge of justice temporarily.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，調宗室永瑋為盛京將軍，慶桂為吉林將軍。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Imperial clansman Yongwei was transferred to be Mukden general; Qing Gui was made Jilin general.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Yongwei became Mukden general and Qing Gui Jilin general.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，陳輝祖褫職逮問，調富勒渾為閩浙總督，福長安署之。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Chen Huizu was stripped of office and arrested for inquiry; Fulehun was transferred to be Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general, with Fu Chang'an acting.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Chen Huizu was arrested, Fulehun became Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general, and Fu Chang'an acted for him.

sentences.zh: 調李世傑為河南巡撫，以查禮為湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: Li Shijie was transferred to be Henan governor; Zha Li was made Hunan governor.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shijie became Henan governor and Zha Li Hunan governor.

sentences.zh: 己未，賑浙江玉環等處海溢災民。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, relief was given for victims of sea overflow disaster in Zhejiang places including Yuhuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Zhejiang coastal flood victims including Yuhuan received relief.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，免奉天承德等五廳縣水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, quota land tax was remitted for five Fengtian departments and counties including Chengde stricken by flood.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, flood quota tax was remitted in five Chengde-area districts.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸酉，新建庫爾喀喇烏蘇城名曰慶綏，晶河城名曰安阜。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day guiyou: the newly built city Kuerkala Wusu was named Qingsui, and Jinghe city was named Anfu.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, new cities were named Qingsui (Kuerkala Wusu) and Anfu (Jinghe).

sentences.zh: 丁卯，賑河南汝陽等十六縣水災。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, relief was given for flood disaster in sixteen Henan counties including Ruyang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, sixteen Henan counties including Ruyang received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 甲申，直隸總督鄭大進卒，以袁守侗署之。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Zhili governor-general Zheng Dajin died; Yuan Shoutong acted in his place.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Zheng Dajin, governor-general of Zhili, died and Yuan Shoutong acted.

sentences.zh: 以福崧為浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: Fu Song was made Zhejiang governor.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Song became governor of Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 賑安徽壽州等十六州縣衛水旱災。

translations.literal: Relief was given for flood and drought disaster in sixteen Anhui prefectures, counties, and guards including Shouzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Flood and drought relief reached sixteen Anhui districts including Shouzhou.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸亥朔，陳輝祖及國棟等論斬。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, new moon on day guihai: Chen Huizu and Guo Dong and others were sentenced to death by decapitation.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Chen Huizu, Guo Dong, and others were sentenced to decapitation.

sentences.zh: 甲申，常青遷杭州將軍。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Chang Qing was transferred to be Hangzhou general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Chang Qing became Hangzhou general.

sentences.zh: 以烏爾圖納遜為察哈爾都統。

translations.literal: Urtunaxun was made Chahar commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Urtunaxun became Chahar commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 四十八年春正月甲午，以伊星阿為湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: Forty-eighth year, spring, first month, day jiawu: Yixing'a was made Hunan governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-eighth year, spring, Yixing'a became Hunan governor.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以薩載為兩江總督，畢沅為陝西巡撫，劉秉恬為雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Sa Zai was made Liangjiang governor-general; Bi Yuan Shaanxi governor; Liu Bingtian Yunnan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Sa Zai took Liangjiang, Bi Yuan Shaanxi, and Liu Bingtian Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 二月甲子，賜陳輝祖自盡，王燧處斬。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiazi: Chen Huizu was granted suicide; Wang Sui was executed by decapitation.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Chen Huizu was allowed suicide and Wang Sui was executed.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以毓奇為漕運總督。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Yu Qi was made grain transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Yu Qi became grain transport governor-general.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以拉旺多爾濟為御前大臣。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Lawang Duo'erji was made imperial presence minister.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Lawang Duo'erji became an imperial presence minister.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，命建辟雍於太學。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, an order was issued to build the Piyong Hall at the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, the court ordered a Piyong built at the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 辛未，上詣西陵，免經過地方額賦十分之三。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, the Emperor proceeded to the Western Tombs and remitted three-tenths of quota tax in places passed through.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, the Emperor visited the Western Tombs and cut passing districts' tax by thirty percent.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，上詣泰陵、泰東陵。

translations.literal: On day yihai, the Emperor proceeded to Tailing and Taidongling.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, the Emperor visited Tailing and Taidongling.

sentences.zh: 戊子，賜明遼東經略熊廷弼五世孫泗先為儒學訓導。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Xiong Tingbi's fifth-generation descendant Si Xian was granted the post of educational instructor in Confucian learning as Ming Liaodong military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Ming general Xiong Tingbi's descendant Si Xian received a Confucian instructor post.

sentences.zh: 三月辛丑，予大學士阿桂等議敘。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinchou: Grand Secretary Agui and others were granted deliberation on merit promotion.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Agui and other grand secretaries received merit review.

sentences.zh: 禮部侍郎錢載等原品休致。

translations.literal: Vice Ministers of Rites Qian Zai and others retired at their original rank.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Ministers Qian Zai and others retired at grade.

sentences.zh: 予總督袁守侗等、巡撫農起等議敘。

translations.literal: Governor-general Yuan Shoutong and others, governors Nong Qi and others were granted deliberation on merit promotion.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Shoutong, Nong Qi, and other governors received merit review.

sentences.zh: 召朱椿來京，以劉峨為廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: Zhu Chun was summoned to the capital; Liu E was made Guangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Chun was recalled to Beijing and Liu E became Guangxi governor.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，免江蘇銅山等十九州縣、淮安等三衛水旱災額賦。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, quota land tax was remitted for nineteen Jiangsu prefectures and counties including Tongshan and three guards including Huai'an stricken by flood and drought.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, flood and drought tax was remitted in nineteen Jiangsu districts and three Huai'an guards.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙丑，御前大臣喀喇沁郡王札拉豐阿卒，以拉旺多爾濟為御前大臣。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yichou: Imperial presence minister, Khalkha Prince Zhala Feng'a died; Lawang Duo'erji was made imperial presence minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Prince Zhala Feng'a died and Lawang Duo'erji replaced him as imperial presence minister.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，上閱火器營兵。

translations.literal: On day yihai, the Emperor reviewed the Firearms Brigade troops.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, the Emperor reviewed firearms troops.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，召福康安來京。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Fukang'an was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Fukang'an was summoned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 五月壬辰，以福康安為正黃旗領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renchen: Fukang'an was made chief commandant eunuch-minister of the Court Guard of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Fukang'an became chief guard minister of the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 予李奉翰兵部尚書、右都御史銜。

translations.literal: Li Fenghan was granted the concurrent titles of Minister of War and Censor-in-chief of the Right.
translations.idiomatic: Li Fenghan received minister of war and right censor-in-chief titles.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以朱椿為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Zhu Chun was made Left Censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Zhu Chun became left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 丙午，協辦大學士、吏部尚書永貴卒。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Associate Grand Secretary and Minister of Personnel Yonggui died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Associate Grand Secretary Yonggui died.

sentences.zh: 免安徽壽州等十一州縣上年水災額賦。

translations.literal: Quota land tax was remitted for eleven Anhui prefectures and counties including Shouzhou stricken by flood the previous year.
translations.idiomatic: Prior-year flood tax was remitted in eleven Anhui districts including Shouzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁未，直隸總督袁守侗卒，以劉峨代之。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Zhili governor-general Yuan Shoutong died; Liu E replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Yuan Shoutong died and Liu E succeeded as Zhili governor-general.

sentences.zh: 以孫士毅為廣西巡撫，伍彌泰為吏部尚書、協辦大學士。

translations.literal: Sun Shiyi was made Guangxi governor; Wu Mitai Minister of Personnel and associate grand secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Shiyi became Guangxi governor and Wu Mitai personnel minister and associate grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 己酉，上有疾，命永瑢代祀方澤。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, the Emperor fell ill and ordered Yong Yu to substitute in sacrificing at the Altar of Earth.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, illness kept the Emperor from the Earth Altar and Yong Yu officiated.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，上幸木蘭。

translations.literal: On day guichou, the Emperor proceeded to Mulan.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, the Emperor went to Mulan.

sentences.zh: 庚申，上駐蹕避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, the Emperor halted at the Mountain Resort for Summer Retreat.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, the Emperor stayed at the Summer Resort.

sentences.zh: 六月乙丑，體仁閣火。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yichou: Tiren Pavilion caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Tiren Pavilion burned.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，免山東永阜等五場上年水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, quota tax was remitted for five Shandong salt-fields including Yongfu stricken by flood the previous year.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, prior-year flood tax was remitted at five Shandong salt-fields including Yongfu.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，賑湖北廣濟等六州縣水災。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, relief was given for flood disaster in six Hubei prefectures and counties including Guangji.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, six Hubei districts including Guangji received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊戌，命海祿署伊犁將軍，圖思義署烏魯木齊都統。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wuxu: Hailu was ordered to act as Ili general; Tusi'i to act as Urumqi commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Hailu acted at Ili and Tusi'i at Urumqi.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，命蔡新為文華殿大學士，梁國治協辦大學士，劉墉為吏部尚書。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Cai Xin was made Grand Secretary of the Wenhua Hall; Liang Guozhi associate grand secretary; Liu Yong Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Cai Xin entered the Wenhua Hall, Liang Guozhi became associate grand secretary, and Liu Yong personnel minister.

sentences.zh: 八月甲午，賜達賴喇嘛玉冊玉寶。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiawu: the Dalai Lama was granted a jade register and jade seal.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, the Dalai Lama received jade patent and seal.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，明亮、巴林泰等褫職逮問，以海祿為烏魯木齊都統。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Mingliang, Balintai, and others were stripped of office and arrested for inquiry; Hailu was made Urumqi commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Mingliang and Balintai were arrested and Hailu became Urumqi commander.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，上自避暑山莊詣盛京謁陵，免經過地方本年額賦十分之五。

translations.literal: On day yihai, the Emperor from the Summer Resort proceeded to Mukden to visit the tombs and remitted five-tenths of this year's quota tax in places passed through.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, the Emperor left the Summer Resort for Mukden tomb rites and halved passing districts' annual tax.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，太子太保、大學士英廉卒。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and Grand Secretary Yinglian died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Grand Secretary Yinglian died.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，上駐蹕哈那達大營。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, the Emperor halted at the Hanada great encampment.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, the Emperor camped at Hanada.

sentences.zh: 喀喇沁郡王喇特納錫第等迎駕，賞賚有差。

translations.literal: Khalkha Prince Late Nasidi and others met the imperial progress; rewards were given in varying measure.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Late Nasidi and others met the Emperor and received graded rewards.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，上駐五里屯大營，科爾沁親王恭格喇布坦、巴林郡王巴圖等迎駕，賞賚有差。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, the Emperor halted at the Wulitun great encampment; Khorchin Prince Gong Gelabutan, Balin Prince Batu, and others met the progress; rewards in varying measure.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, at Wulitun camp Khorchin and Balin princes met the Emperor and were rewarded.

sentences.zh: 戊子，予明遼東經略袁崇煥五世孫炳以八九品官選補。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Yuan Chonghuan's fifth-generation descendant Bing was granted selection and appointment to an eighth- or ninth-rank post as Ming Liaodong military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Ming commander Yuan Chonghuan's descendant Bing received an eighth- or ninth-rank post.

sentences.zh: 九月己丑朔，上駐蹕四堡子東大營閱射。

translations.literal: Ninth month, new moon on day jichou: the Emperor halted at the Sibuzi East great encampment and reviewed archery.
translations.idiomatic: At the new moon of the ninth month, the Emperor reviewed archery at Sibuzi East camp.

sentences.zh: 命皇十一子永瑆等迎冊寶至盛京，藏於太廟。

translations.literal: The eleventh prince Yong Xuan and others were ordered to welcome the patent and seal to Mukden and store them in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yong Xuan and others were sent to bring patent and seal to Mukden for the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，上駐老邊大營閱射。

translations.literal: On day guisi, the Emperor halted at the Laobian great encampment and reviewed archery.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, the Emperor reviewed archery at Laobian camp.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮國王遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: The King of Korea sent envoys presenting local products as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 乙未，免奉天各屬乾隆四十九年額賦。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, quota land tax for the forty-ninth year of Qianlong was remitted for all Fengtian dependencies.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Fengtian's forty-ninth-year quota tax was remitted.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，上謁永陵。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, the Emperor visited Yongling.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, the Emperor visited Yongling.

sentences.zh: 己亥，行大饗禮。

translations.literal: On day jihai, the great offering sacrifice was performed.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, the great offering rite was held.

sentences.zh: 閱興京城。

translations.literal: Xingjing city was inspected.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor inspected Mukden (Xingjing).

sentences.zh: 免盛京戶部各庄頭倉糧。

translations.literal: Grain from the granaries of all estate heads under the Mukden Revenue Board was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Mukden estate granary grain was remitted.

sentences.zh: 免盛京等處旗地應納米豆草束十分之五。

translations.literal: Five-tenths of the rice, beans, and fodder due on banner land in Mukden and elsewhere was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Half the grain and fodder due on Mukden banner land was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 減奉天等處死罪，免軍流以下罪。

translations.literal: Capital crimes in Fengtian and elsewhere were reduced; punishments below exile were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Capital sentences in Fengtian were reduced and lesser crimes pardoned.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，上謁福陵。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the Emperor visited Fuling.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, the Emperor visited Fuling.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，行大饗禮。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, the great offering sacrifice was performed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, the great offering rite was held.

sentences.zh: 上謁昭陵，臨奠武勛王揚古利墓。

translations.literal: The Emperor visited Zhaoling and personally offered at the tomb of Merit King Yangguli.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor visited Zhaoling and mourned at Merit King Yangguli's tomb.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，行大饗禮。

translations.literal: On day yisi, the great offering sacrifice was performed.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, the great offering rite was held.

sentences.zh: 丙午，上臨奠克勤郡王岳託墓。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, the Emperor personally offered at the tomb of Prince Keqin Yuetuo.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, the Emperor mourned at Prince Keqin Yuetuo's tomb.

sentences.zh: 丁未，上臨奠弘毅公額亦都、直義公費英東墓。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the Emperor personally offered at the tombs of Duke Hongyi Ebilun and Duke Zhiyi Feiyingdong.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, the Emperor mourned at Dukes Ebilun and Feiyingdong's tombs.

sentences.zh: 戊申，上御崇政殿受慶賀。

translations.literal: On day wushen, the Emperor took the throne in the Chongzheng Hall to receive congratulatory rites.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, the Emperor received congratulations in Chongzheng Hall.

sentences.zh: 御大政殿賜扈從皇子、王、公、大臣等宴，賞賚有差。

translations.literal: At the Dazheng Hall he bestowed a banquet on princes, nobles, and ministers in attendance and gave rewards in varying measure.
translations.idiomatic: At Dazheng Hall the Emperor feasted the entourage and gave graded rewards.

sentences.zh: 己酉，上詣清寧宮祭神，賜皇子、王、公、大臣等食胙。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, the Emperor proceeded to the Qingning Palace to sacrifice to the spirits and bestowed sacrificial meat on princes, nobles, and ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, at Qingning Palace the Emperor sacrificed and shared sacrificial meat with the court.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，上回蹕。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, the Emperor returned from progress.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, the Emperor began the return journey.

sentences.zh: 戊午，申諭詹事府備詞臣升轉之階，及建儲之必不可行。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, instructions were issued to the Court of the Heir Apparent's Household to prepare promotion steps for literary officials, and that establishing an heir apparent was absolutely impermissible.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, the court told the Heir Apparent's office to rank scholar-officials for promotion and forbade designating an heir.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬戌，賑陝西榆林八州縣等旱災。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day renxu: famine relief was distributed for drought in eight prefectures and counties including Yulin in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on renxu day, drought relief reached eight Shaanxi districts including Yulin.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，上駐蹕文殊菴行宮。

translations.literal: On day guihai, the Emperor halted at Wenshuyan Traveling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, the Emperor stayed at Wenshuyan Palace.

sentences.zh: 壬申，上謁昭西陵、孝陵、孝東陵、景陵。

translations.literal: On day renshen, the Emperor paid respects at Zhaoxiling, Xiaoling, Xiaodongling, and Jingling.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, the Emperor worshipped at four imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day yihai, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 十一月己亥，釋國棟。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jihai: Guo Dong was released.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jihai day, Guo Dong was freed.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以福隆安病未痊，命福康安協同辦理兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, because Fu Long'an had not recovered from illness, Fu Kang'an was ordered jointly to handle affairs as Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Fu Kang'an shared the war ministry while Fu Long'an convalesced.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，命劉峨飭玉田附近州縣掘蝗蝻。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Liu E was ordered to direct nearby prefectures and counties around Yutian to dig out locust nymphs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Liu E ordered Yutian-area districts to dig out locust nymphs.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，命劉峨查辦南宮縣義和拳邪教。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Liu E was ordered to investigate and handle the Yihequan heterodox sect in Nan'gong county.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Liu E was sent to suppress the Yihequan sect in Nan'gong.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以阿克棟阿為烏里雅蘇台參贊大臣，那爾瑚善為塔爾巴哈台參贊大臣。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Akedong'a was made Commissioner Assistant at Uliastai and Na'erhushan Commissioner Assistant at Tarbagatai.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Akedong'a took Uliastai and Na'erhushan, Tarbagatai.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙寅，命福康安赴廣東，會同永德讞鹽商獄。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day bingyin: Fu Kang'an was ordered to Guangdong to join Yongde in adjudicating the salt-merchant case.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingyin day, Fu Kang'an went to Guangdong for the salt-merchant trial with Yongde.

sentences.zh: 四十九年春正月丁未，上南巡，免直隸、山東經過地方本年錢糧十分之三。
