translations.literal: Forty-ninth year, spring, first month, day dingwei: the Emperor made a southern tour; grain taxes on the route in Zhili and Shandong were remitted by three-tenths for the current year.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the forty-ninth year, on dingwei day, the southern tour began with a three-tenths tax cut on the Zhili and Shandong route.

sentences.zh: 戊申，免直隸順天等十二府州屬逋賦。

translations.literal: On day wushen, accumulated tax arrears were remitted for twelve Zhili prefectures and subordinate units including Shuntian.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, back taxes were forgiven in twelve Zhili districts including Shuntian.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，調孫士毅為廣東巡撫，以吳垣為廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Sun Shiyi was transferred to be Guangdong governor and Wu Yuan Guangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Sun Shiyi took Guangdong and Wu Yuan, Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，免山東利津等二十一州縣衛逋賦。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, accumulated tax arrears were remitted for twenty-one Shandong prefectures, counties, and guards including Lijin.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, back taxes were forgiven in twenty-one Shandong districts including Lijin.

sentences.zh: 召巴延三來京，調舒常為兩廣總督。

translations.literal: Bayansan was summoned to the capital; Shuchang was transferred to be governor-general of the Two Guangs.
translations.idiomatic: Bayansan was called to Beijing; Shuchang became governor-general of the Two Guangs.

sentences.zh: 以特成額為湖廣總督，保寧為成都將軍。

translations.literal: Techeng'e was made Huguang governor-general and Baoning General of Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: Techeng'e took Huguang; Baoning became Chengdu general.

sentences.zh: 二月壬戌，上幸泰安府，詣岱廟行禮。

translations.literal: Second month, day renxu: the Emperor visited Tai'an prefecture and performed rites at Mount Tai temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renxu day, the Emperor worshipped at Mount Tai.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，上謁少昊陵。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, the Emperor paid respects at Shaohao's tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, the Emperor visited Shaohao's tomb.

sentences.zh: 至曲阜謁先師廟。

translations.literal: He arrived at Qufu and paid respects at the temple of the First Teacher.
translations.idiomatic: At Qufu the Emperor worshipped at Confucius' temple.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，釋奠先師，詣孔林酹酒。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, he offered sacrifice to the First Teacher and poured libation wine at the Kong family grove.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, the Emperor sacrificed to Confucius and offered wine at the Kong grove.

sentences.zh: 祭元聖周公廟。

translations.literal: He sacrificed at the temple of the Primordial Sage Duke of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor sacrificed at the Duke of Zhou's temple.

sentences.zh: 壬申，免江寧、蘇州、安徽各屬逋賦。

translations.literal: On day renshen, accumulated tax arrears were remitted for subordinate units of Jiangning, Suzhou, and Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, back taxes were forgiven in Jiangning, Suzhou, and Anhui districts.

sentences.zh: 免江南、浙江經過地方本年錢糧十分之三。

translations.literal: Grain taxes on the route in Jiangnan and Zhejiang were remitted by three-tenths for the current year.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiangnan and Zhejiang route received a three-tenths grain-tax remission.

sentences.zh: 以永保為貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: Yongbao was made Guizhou governor.
translations.idiomatic: Yongbao became Guizhou governor.

sentences.zh: 賚江南、浙江耆民。

translations.literal: Elderly residents of Jiangnan and Zhejiang were rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: The court rewarded elderly residents of Jiangnan and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，祭河神。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, the River God was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, the Emperor sacrificed to the River God.

sentences.zh: 上渡河。

translations.literal: The Emperor crossed the river.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor crossed the river.

sentences.zh: 減江蘇、安徽、浙江三省軍流以下罪。

translations.literal: Punishments for military exile and below were reduced in Jiangsu, Anhui, and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangsu, Anhui, and Zhejiang received sentence reductions below military exile.

sentences.zh: 壬午，免江南江寧、蘇州，浙江杭州等附郭諸縣額賦。

translations.literal: On day renwu, quota land tax was remitted for prefecture-girdle counties including Jiangning and Suzhou in Jiangnan and Hangzhou in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, prefecture-girdle land tax was remitted in Jiangning, Suzhou, and Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲申，免兩淮灶戶四十五、六兩年逋賦。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, accumulated salt-field levies for the forty-fifth and forty-sixth years were remitted for the Two Huai salt households.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Two Huai salt-field arrears from years 45–46 were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 三月丙戌朔，祭江神。

translations.literal: Third month, first day bingxu, new moon: the River God was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: At the third-month new moon, the Emperor sacrificed to the River God.

sentences.zh: 上渡江，幸金山。

translations.literal: The Emperor crossed the river and visited Jinshan.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor crossed the river and visited Jinshan.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，上幸焦山。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, the Emperor visited Jiaoshan.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, the Emperor visited Jiaoshan.

sentences.zh: 調周煌為左都御史。

translations.literal: Zhou Huang was transferred to be Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Huang became Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以王傑為兵部尚書，俟服闋後供職。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Wang Jie was made Minister of War, to take office after mourning ended.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Wang Jie was named war minister pending the end of mourning.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，上幸蘇州府。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, the Emperor visited Suzhou prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, the Emperor visited Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，免湖北江夏等二十四州縣衛三十年至四十四年逋賦。

translations.literal: On day renchen, accumulated tax arrears from the thirtieth through forty-fourth years were remitted for twenty-four Hubei prefectures, counties, and guards including Jiangxia.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Hubei back taxes from years 30–44 were forgiven in twenty-four districts including Jiangxia.

sentences.zh: 乙未，上詣文廟行禮。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, the Emperor performed rites at the Confucian temple.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, the Emperor worshipped at the Confucian temple.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，再免浙江杭州、嘉興、湖州三府屬額賦十分之三。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, quota land tax in subordinate units of Hangzhou, Jiaxing, and Huzhou in Zhejiang was again remitted by three-tenths.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Hangzhou, Jiaxing, and Huzhou received another three-tenths land-tax cut.

sentences.zh: 己亥，上幸海寧州祭海神。

translations.literal: On day jihai, the Emperor visited Haining prefecture to sacrifice to the Sea God.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, the Emperor sacrificed to the Sea God at Haining.

sentences.zh: 以福建欽賜進士郭鍾岳年屆一百四歲，來浙迎鑾，賞國子監司業。

translations.literal: Because the Fujian imperial tribute graduate Guo Zhongyue, aged one hundred four, came to Zhejiang to welcome the imperial procession, he was rewarded with the post of Vice Director of the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Zhongyue of Fujian, aged 104, was made vice director of education for greeting the tour in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 庚子，上幸尖山觀潮。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, the Emperor visited Jianshan to view the tide.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, the Emperor watched the tide at Jianshan.

sentences.zh: 閱視塘工。

translations.literal: He inspected the seawall works.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor inspected the seawall.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，上幸杭州府。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, the Emperor visited Hangzhou prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, the Emperor visited Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，上詣聖因寺祭聖祖神御。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the Emperor paid respects at the imperial portrait of the Founding Emperor at Shengyin Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, the Emperor worshipped Kangxi's portrait at Shengyin Temple.

sentences.zh: 戊申，上閱福建水師。

translations.literal: On day wushen, the Emperor reviewed the Fujian naval forces.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, the Emperor reviewed Fujian naval troops.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，上自杭州迴鑾。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, the Emperor returned from Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, the court left Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 改慶桂為福州將軍。

translations.literal: Qinggui was transferred to be General of Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Qinggui became Fuzhou general.

sentences.zh: 以都爾嘉為吉林將軍。

translations.literal: Du'erjia was made General of Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: Du'erjia became Jilin general.

sentences.zh: 增西安副都統一。

translations.literal: One additional deputy lieutenant-general was added at Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: Xi'an gained an additional deputy lieutenant-general.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，上駐蹕蘇州府。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the Emperor halted at Suzhou prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, the Emperor stayed at Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 巴延三褫職。

translations.literal: Bayansan was stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: Bayansan lost his post.

sentences.zh: 閏三月丙辰朔，兵部尚書福隆安卒，以福康安為兵部尚書，復興署工部尚書。

translations.literal: Intercalary third month, first day bingchen, new moon: Minister of War Fu Long'an died; Fu Kang'an was made Minister of War and Fu Xing again acted as Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: At the intercalary third-month new moon, Fu Long'an died; Fu Kang'an took the war ministry and Fu Xing again acted at works.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，上幸江寧府。

translations.literal: On day renxu, the Emperor visited Jiangning prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, the Emperor visited Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 甲子，祭明太祖陵。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, the tomb of the Ming founder was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, the Emperor worshipped at the Ming founder's tomb.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，上閱江寧府駐防兵。

translations.literal: On day yichou, the Emperor reviewed the garrison troops at Jiangning prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, the Emperor reviewed Jiangning garrison troops.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，上渡江。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, the Emperor crossed the river.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, the Emperor crossed the river.

sentences.zh: 丙子，上祭河神，渡河。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, the River God was sacrificed to and the river was crossed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, the Emperor sacrificed to the River God and crossed the river.

sentences.zh: 以伊齡阿為總管內務府大臣。

translations.literal: Yiling'a was made Director-General of the Imperial Household Department.
translations.idiomatic: Yiling'a became director-general of the imperial household.

sentences.zh: 是月，免江蘇上元等八州縣衛，安徽懷寧等十州縣、安慶等三衛上年水旱災額賦。

translations.literal: That month, quota land tax for last year's flood and drought disasters was remitted for eight Jiangsu prefectures, counties, and guards including Shangyuan and ten Anhui prefectures and counties and three guards including Huaining.
translations.idiomatic: That month, prior-year flood and drought land tax was remitted in eight Jiangsu and ten Anhui districts.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙戌，免直隸宛平等五州縣上年水災額賦。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day bingxu: quota land tax for last year's flood was remitted for five Zhili prefectures and counties including Wanping.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month, on bingxu day, prior-year flood land tax was remitted in five Zhili districts including Wanping.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，上祭禹廟。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, the Emperor sacrificed at Yu's temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, the Emperor worshipped at Yu's temple.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以李綬為江西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Li Shou was made Jiangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Li Shou became Jiangxi governor.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以河南衛輝等屬旱，免汲縣等十六縣逋賦。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, because Weihui and other subordinate units in Henan suffered drought, accumulated tax arrears were remitted for sixteen counties including Ji county.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, drought led to back-tax remission in sixteen Henan counties including Ji.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，免直隸大名等七州縣逋賦。

translations.literal: On day yisi, accumulated tax arrears were remitted for seven Zhili prefectures and counties including Daming.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, back taxes were forgiven in seven Zhili districts including Daming.

sentences.zh: 丙午，甘肅新教回人田五等作亂，命李侍堯、剛塔剿之。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Tian Wu and others of the New Teaching among the Hui of Gansu rose in rebellion; Li Shiyao and Gangta were ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Tian Wu's Gansu Hui rebels rose; Li Shiyao and Gangta were sent against them.

sentences.zh: 丁未，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 以海祿為烏什參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Hailu was made Commissioner Assistant at Ush.
translations.idiomatic: Hailu became Ush commissioner assistant.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，免陝西、甘肅三十八年至四十六年逋賦。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, accumulated tax arrears from the thirty-eighth through forty-sixth years were remitted in Shaanxi and Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Shaanxi and Gansu back taxes from years 38–46 were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，調李綬為湖南巡撫，以伊星阿為江西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Li Shou was transferred to be Hunan governor and Yixing'a Jiangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Li Shou took Hunan and Yixing'a, Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，賜茹棻等一百十二人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Rufen and one hundred eleven others were granted metropolitan graduate degrees with distinctions in rank.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Rufen and 111 others received metropolitan degrees with graded honors.

sentences.zh: 是月，免湖北黃梅等四縣、武昌等三衛上年水災額賦。

translations.literal: That month, quota land tax for last year's flood was remitted for four Hubei counties including Huangmei and three guards including Wuchang.
translations.idiomatic: That month, prior-year flood land tax was remitted in four Hubei counties and three guards.

sentences.zh: 五月丙辰，綽克托以緣事褫職逮問，以慶桂為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingchen: Chuoketuo was stripped of office and arrested on account of a related matter; Qinggui was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingchen day, Chuoketuo was arrested and Qinggui became works minister.

sentences.zh: 調常青為福州將軍，以永鐸為杭州將軍。

translations.literal: Changqing was transferred to be General of Fuzhou and Yongduo General of Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Changqing took Fuzhou; Yongduo, Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 己未，命慶桂在軍機處行走。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Qinggui was ordered to serve in the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Qinggui entered the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，上秋獮木蘭。

translations.literal: On day renxu, the Emperor went on the autumn hunt to Mulan.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, the Emperor hunted at Mulan.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，免陝西延安等三府州逋賦。

translations.literal: On day guihai, accumulated tax arrears were remitted for three Shaanxi prefectures and departments including Yan'an.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, back taxes were forgiven in three Shaanxi districts including Yan'an.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，上駐蹕避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, the Emperor halted at the Mountain Resort for Summer.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, the Emperor stayed at the summer resort.

sentences.zh: 己巳，命福康安、海蘭察赴甘肅剿捕回匪。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Fu Kang'an and Hailancha were ordered to Gansu to suppress and capture Hui bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Fu Kang'an and Hailancha were sent to Gansu against Hui rebels.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，命阿桂領火器、健銳兩營兵往甘肅剿叛回。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, A Gui was ordered to lead Firearms and Vanguard troops to Gansu to suppress rebellious Hui.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, A Gui took firearms and vanguard troops to Gansu against rebel Hui.

sentences.zh: 以阿桂為將軍，福康安、海蘭察、伍岱並為參贊大臣。

translations.literal: A Gui was made general; Fu Kang'an, Hailancha, and Wudai were all made commissioner assistants.
translations.idiomatic: A Gui became general; Fu Kang'an, Hailancha, and Wudai became commissioner assistants.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，甘肅回匪陷通渭縣，尋復之。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Gansu Hui bandits captured Tongwei county but soon recovered it.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Hui rebels briefly took Tongwei and were driven out.

sentences.zh: 以舒亮為領隊大臣。

translations.literal: Shuliang was made lead commander.
translations.idiomatic: Shuliang became lead commander.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，李侍堯坐玩誤褫職，以福康安為陝甘總督。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Li Shiyao was stripped of office for negligence; Fu Kang'an was made Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Li Shiyao lost his post for negligence and Fu Kang'an took Shaanxi-Gansu.

sentences.zh: 剛塔以失機褫職逮問。

translations.literal: Gangta was stripped of office and arrested for missing his opportunity.
translations.idiomatic: Gangta was arrested for military failure.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，調慶桂為兵部尚書，復興為工部尚書。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Qinggui was transferred to be Minister of War and Fu Xing again Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Qinggui took the war ministry and Fu Xing again took works.

sentences.zh: 以阿揚阿為左都御史。

translations.literal: Ayang'a was made Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Ayang'a became Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 癸未，江南巡撫郝碩坐貪婪逮問。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Jiangnan governor Hao Shuo was arrested for greed.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Jiangnan governor Hao Shuo was arrested for corruption.

sentences.zh: 是月，免山東兗州等三府州屬上年水災額賦。

translations.literal: That month, quota land tax for last year's flood was remitted for subordinate units of three Shandong prefectures and departments including Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month, prior-year flood land tax was remitted in three Shandong prefectures including Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 六月庚寅，免甘肅本年額賦。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengyin: quota land tax for the current year was remitted in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengyin day, Gansu's current-year land tax was remitted.

sentences.zh: 甲午，賑湖南茶陵、攸縣水災。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, flood relief was distributed for the flood disaster in Chaling and You counties in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, flood relief reached Chaling and You in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，東閣大學士三寶卒。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Eastern Lodge Grand Secretary Sanbao died.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Grand Secretary Sanbao died.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以書麟為安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Shulin was made Anhui governor.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Shulin became Anhui governor.

sentences.zh: 是月，免安徽懷寧等十三州縣衛上年水旱額賦。

translations.literal: That month, quota land tax for last year's flood and drought was remitted for thirteen Anhui prefectures, counties, and guards including Huaining.
translations.idiomatic: That month, prior-year flood and drought land tax was remitted in thirteen Anhui districts.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲寅朔，日食。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, first day jiayin, new moon: solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: At the seventh-month new moon, a solar eclipse occurred.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，禮部尚書曹秀先卒，以姚成烈為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Minister of Rites Cao Xiuxian died; Yao Chengilie was made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Cao Xiuxian died; Yao Chengilie took the rites ministry.

sentences.zh: 調李綬為湖北巡撫，以陸翟為湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: Li Shou was transferred to be Hubei governor and Luzhai Hunan governor.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shou took Hubei; Luzhai, Hunan.

sentences.zh: 己未，賜郝碩自裁。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Hao Shuo was granted permission to commit suicide.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Hao Shuo was allowed to take his own life.

sentences.zh: 甲子，甘肅石峰堡回匪平，俘賊首張文慶等。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, the Gansu Shifengbao Hui bandits were pacified and bandit leaders including Zhang Wenqing were captured.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Shifengbao rebels in Gansu were crushed and Zhang Wenqing and other leaders were taken.

sentences.zh: 予阿桂輕車都尉，晉封福康安嘉勇侯，擢海蘭察子安祿二等侍衛，授伍岱都統，俱給騎都尉，和珅再給輕車都尉，餘各甄敘有差。

translations.literal: Agui was granted Chariot Commandant; Fukang'an was advanced to Marquis Jia-yong with courage; Hai Lancha's son Anlu was promoted to second-rank bodyguard; Wu Dai was made commander-in-chief; all were given Commandant of Cavalry rank; Heshen was again granted Chariot Commandant; the rest received differentiated promotions and rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Agui received Chariot Commandant; Fukang'an was made Marquis Jia-yong; Anlu, Hai Lancha's son, became a second-rank guard; Wu Dai took command; all gained cavalry commandant rank; Heshen received Chariot Commandant again; others were promoted by degree.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以常青為烏魯木齊都統。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Changqing was made Urumqi commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Changqing became Urumqi commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以伍彌泰為東閣大學士。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Wu Mitai was made Grand Secretary of the Eastern Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Wu Mitai became an Eastern Pavilion grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 調和珅為吏部尚書、協辦大學士，兼管戶部。

translations.literal: Heshen was transferred to Minister of Personnel, associate grand secretary, concurrently overseeing the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Heshen took personnel, became associate grand secretary, and kept charge of revenue.

sentences.zh: 以福康安為戶部尚書，仍留陝西總督任。

translations.literal: Fukang'an was made Minister of Revenue while remaining Shaanxi governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Fukang'an became revenue minister while staying Shaanxi governor-general.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，命頒行軍紀律。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, military discipline regulations were ordered promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, army discipline regulations were ordered issued.

sentences.zh: 癸未，李侍堯論斬。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, Li Shiyao was sentenced to execution.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, Li Shiyao was sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 宥剛塔罪，戍伊犁。

translations.literal: Gangta's crime was pardoned; he was banished to serve at Ili.
translations.idiomatic: Gangta was pardoned and sent to serve exile at Ili.

sentences.zh: 是月，免陝西榆林等八州縣上年旱災額賦。

translations.literal: That month, quota land tax from the previous year's drought disaster was remitted for eight prefectures and counties including Yulin in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: That month, last year's drought taxes were remitted in eight Shaanxi districts including Yulin.

sentences.zh: 八月己丑，河南睢州河決，命阿桂督治之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jichou: the Yellow River breached at Suizhou, Henan; Agui was ordered to supervise repairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jichou day, the Suizhou river broke in Henan and Agui was ordered to repair it.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，免甘肅積年逋賦銀三十五萬兩、糧四十七萬石各有差。

translations.literal: On day guisi, accumulated tax arrears were remitted in Gansu—350,000 taels of silver and 470,000 shi of grain, each by varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Gansu back taxes of 350,000 taels and 470,000 shi of grain were forgiven by degree.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以河南偃師縣任天篤九世同居，賜御制詩御書扁額。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, because Ren Tiandu of Yanshi County, Henan, had nine generations living together, imperially composed verse and an imperially written plaque were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Ren Tiandu of Yanshi, Henan, received an imperial poem and plaque for nine generations under one roof.

sentences.zh: 己亥，上幸木蘭行圍。

translations.literal: On day jihai, the Emperor went to Mulan for the enclosure hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, the Emperor hunted at Mulan.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，張文慶等伏誅。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Zhang Wenqing and others were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Zhang Wenqing and others were put to death.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，暹羅國長鄭華遣陪臣貢方物，乞封。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Siam's chief Zheng Hua sent an attendant minister with tribute goods, requesting investiture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Siam's Zheng Hua sent tribute and asked for investiture.

sentences.zh: 九月癸丑朔，賑安徽宿州等處水災。

translations.literal: Ninth month, new moon on day guichou: flood relief was given for Anhui districts including Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: At the ninth-month new moon, flood relief went to Anhui districts including Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以回匪平，封和珅一等男。

translations.literal: On day yimao, because the Muslim rebels had been pacified, Heshen was enfeoffed as a first-class baron.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Heshen was made a first-class baron after the Muslim rebels were pacified.

sentences.zh: 庚申，上駐蹕避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, the Emperor halted at the Mountain Resort for Avoiding Summer Heat.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, the Emperor stayed at the Summer Resort.

sentences.zh: 甲子，調烏爾圖納遜為察哈爾都統，積福為綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Wuer'tunaxun was transferred to Chahar commander-in-chief; Jifu was made Suiyuan city general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Wuer'tunaxun took Chahar command and Jifu became Suiyuan general.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 丙子，宥綽克托罪。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Chuoketuo's crime was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Chuoketuo was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，命內大臣西明、翰林院侍讀學士阿肅使朝鮮，冊封世子。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Interior Minister Ximing and Hanlin Academy Reader-in-Waiting Asu were ordered to Korea to invest the heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Ximing and Asu were sent to Korea to invest the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑陝西華州等三州縣水災。

translations.literal: That month, flood relief was given for three Shaanxi districts including Huazhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month, flood relief went to three Shaanxi districts including Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛卯，命重舉千叟宴。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day xinmao: the Feast of a Thousand Elders was ordered held again.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on xinmao day, the Thousand Elder Banquet was ordered held again.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，賑江西南昌等六縣水災。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, flood relief was given for six Jiangxi counties including Nanchang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, flood relief went to six Jiangxi counties including Nanchang.

sentences.zh: 己酉，減京師朝審情實句到逾三次人犯罪。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, penalties were reduced for persons in the Beijing autumn and court reviews whose death sentences had been confirmed more than three times.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, penalties were reduced for Beijing review prisoners confirmed to death more than three times.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙丑，諭秋審、朝審各犯緩決至三次者，分別減等。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yichou: an edict ordered differentiated grade reduction for autumn and court review prisoners deferred three times.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yichou day, prisoners deferred three times in autumn and court review were reduced by degree.

sentences.zh: 壬申，睢州河工合龍。

translations.literal: On day renshen, the Suizhou river works were closed and joined.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, the Suizhou river works were closed.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，命留保住為駐藏大臣，以福祿為西寧辦事大臣。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Liubao was ordered to be resident minister in Tibet; Fulu was made Xining affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Liubao was posted to Tibet and Fulu became Xining commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲辰，諭預千叟宴官民年九十以上者，許其子孫一人扶掖；

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiachen: an edict for the forthcoming Feast of a Thousand Elders allowed one descendant to support officials and commoners aged ninety or above;
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiachen day, the court allowed one descendant to assist officials and commoners aged ninety or above at the Thousand Elder Banquet;

sentences.zh: 大臣年逾七十者，如步履稍艱，亦許其子孫一人扶掖。

translations.literal: for ministers past seventy, if walking was somewhat difficult, one descendant was also permitted to support them.
translations.idiomatic: ministers past seventy who walked with difficulty could also have one descendant assist them.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮、琉球、暹羅、安南來貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea, Ryukyu, Siam, and Annam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Korea, Ryukyu, Siam, and Annam paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 五十年春正月辛亥朔，上以五十年國慶，頒詔覃恩有差。

translations.literal: Fiftieth year, spring, first month, new moon on day xinhai: because of the fiftieth-year national celebration, an edict of grace was promulgated with differentiated favors.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the fiftieth year, on the first-month new moon, Hongli issued a differentiated grace edict for the jubilee.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，舉千叟宴禮，宴親王以下三千人於乾清宮，賞賚有差。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, the Feast of a Thousand Elders ceremony was held, entertaining three thousand persons from princes downward in the Palace of Heavenly Purity, with differentiated rewards.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, three thousand guests from princes downward were feasted in the Palace of Heavenly Purity at the Thousand Elder Banquet, with rewards by degree.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，左都御史周煌致仕，以紀昀為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Left Censor-in-Chief Zhou Huang retired; Ji Yun was made Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Zhou Huang retired as left censor-in-chief and Ji Yun succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 調吳垣為湖北巡撫，以孫永清為廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: Wu Yuan was transferred to Hubei governor; Sun Yongqing was made Guangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Yuan took Hubei and Sun Yongqing took Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，召奎林來京，以拉旺多爾濟署烏里雅蘇台將軍。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Kuilin was summoned to the capital; Lawangduoerji acted as Uliasutai general.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Kuilin was recalled to Beijing and Lawangduoerji acted as Uliasutai general.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，喀什噶爾阿奇木伯克阿里木以潛與薩木薩克交通事覺，處斬。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Kashgar's Akim Beg Alimu was executed when his secret contact with Samarkand was discovered.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Kashgar beg Alimu was executed for secret dealings with Samarkand.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，賑江西萍鄉等三縣水災。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, flood relief was given for three Jiangxi counties including Pingxiang.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, flood relief went to three Jiangxi counties including Pingxiang.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，上釋奠先師，臨辟雍講學。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, the Emperor offered sacrifice to the First Teacher and lectured at the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, the Emperor sacrificed to Confucius and lectured at the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 戊子，免河南汲縣等十四縣逋賦。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, tax arrears were remitted for fourteen Henan counties including Jixian.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, back taxes were remitted in fourteen Henan counties including Jixian.

sentences.zh: 己丑，御試翰林院、詹事府官，擢陸伯焜、吳璥為一等，餘升黜有差。

translations.literal: On day jichou, the Emperor examined Hanlin Academy and Household of the Heir Apparent officials, promoting Lu Bokun and Wu Jing to first rank; the rest were promoted or demoted by degree.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, the Emperor tested Hanlin and heir-apparent officials, ranking Lu Bokun and Wu Jing first; others rose or fell by degree.

sentences.zh: 試六部升用翰詹等官，擢慶齡為一等，餘升黜有差。

translations.literal: Officials of the Six Ministries promoted to Hanlin and related posts were examined; Qingling was raised to first rank; the rest were promoted or demoted by degree.
translations.idiomatic: Six-Ministry officials promoted to Hanlin posts were examined; Qingling ranked first; others rose or fell by degree.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，調畢沅為河南巡撫，何裕城為陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Bi Yuan was transferred to Henan governor; He Yucheng to Shaanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Bi Yuan took Henan and He Yucheng took Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，免江南江寧等六府州逋賦。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, tax arrears were remitted for six Jiangnan prefectures and departments including Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, back taxes were remitted in six Jiangnan districts including Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑江西萍鄉等三縣、福建建安等二縣水災，河南汲縣等十四縣旱災。

translations.literal: That month, flood relief was given for three Jiangxi counties including Pingxiang and two Fujian counties including Jian'an; drought relief for fourteen Henan counties including Jixian.
translations.idiomatic: That month, floods were relieved in three Jiangxi and two Fujian counties; drought was relieved in fourteen Henan counties including Jixian.

sentences.zh: 三月壬子，上幸盤山。

translations.literal: Third month, day renzi: the Emperor went to Mount Pan.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renzi day, the Emperor went to Mount Pan.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，上詣明長陵奠酒。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the Emperor went to the Ming Changling mausoleum to offer libations.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, the Emperor offered libations at the Ming Changling.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，上駐蹕盤山。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, the Emperor halted at Mount Pan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, the Emperor stayed at Mount Pan.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，截河南、山東漕糧三十萬石，賑河南衛輝旱災。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, 300,000 shi of canal grain from Henan and Shandong were diverted to relieve drought in Weihui, Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, 300,000 shi of Henan and Shandong canal grain were sent to drought-stricken Weihui.

sentences.zh: 甲子，免江蘇安東、阜寧逋賦。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, tax arrears were remitted for Andong and Funing in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, back taxes were remitted in Jiangsu's Andong and Funing.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以永鐸為伊犁參贊大臣，常青為西安將軍，奎林為烏魯木齊都統，復興為烏里雅蘇台將軍。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Yongduo was made Ili councilor; Changqing, Xi'an general; Kuilin, Urumqi commander-in-chief; Fuxing, Uliasutai general.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Yongduo took Ili, Changqing Xi'an, Kuilin Urumqi, and Fuxing Uliasutai.

sentences.zh: 以舒常為工部尚書，孫士毅兼署兩廣總督。

translations.literal: Shuchang was made Minister of Works; Sun Shiyi concurrently acted as Liangguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Shuchang became works minister and Sun Shiyi acted as Liangguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，免直隸霸州等四十九州縣逋賦。

translations.literal: On day yihai, tax arrears were remitted for forty-nine Zhili prefectures and counties including Bazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, back taxes were remitted in forty-nine Zhili districts including Bazhou.

sentences.zh: 丙子，免河南商丘等六州縣上年水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, quota land tax from the previous year's flood disaster was remitted for six Henan prefectures and counties including Shangqiu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, last year's flood taxes were remitted in six Henan districts including Shangqiu.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲申，甘肅肅州等處地震，賑恤之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiashen: earthquake at Suzhou and elsewhere in Gansu; relief was given.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month, on jiashen day, Gansu districts including Suzhou were earthquake-stricken and relieved.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，上閱健銳營兵。

translations.literal: On day renchen, the Emperor reviewed troops of the Jianrui Camp.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, the Emperor reviewed Jianrui Camp troops.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，刑部尚書喀寧阿、胡季堂，侍郎穆精阿、姜晟以檢驗失實，降四品頂戴。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Ministers of Punishments Kaning'a and Hu Jitang and Vice Ministers Mu Jing'a and Jiang Sheng, for incorrect forensic examination, were demoted to fourth-rank hat knobs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Kaning'a, Hu Jitang, Mu Jing'a, and Jiang Sheng lost rank for faulty forensic findings.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，大學士蔡新致仕。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Grand Secretary Cai Xin retired.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Grand Secretary Cai Xin retired.

sentences.zh: 是月，免河南汲縣等旱災額賦。

translations.literal: That month, drought-disaster quota land tax was remitted for Henan counties including Jixian.
translations.idiomatic: That month, drought quota taxes were remitted in Henan counties including Jixian.

sentences.zh: 賑祥符等州縣旱災。

translations.literal: Drought relief was given for districts including Xiangfu.
translations.idiomatic: Drought relief went to districts including Xiangfu.

sentences.zh: 五月壬子，免河南祥符等十六州縣、鄭州等三十二州縣新舊額賦積欠。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renzi: accumulated new and old quota land tax arrears were remitted for sixteen Henan prefectures and counties including Xiangfu and thirty-two including Zhengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renzi day, new and old quota tax arrears were remitted in sixteen Henan districts including Xiangfu and thirty-two including Zhengzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，調永保為江西巡撫，陳用敷為貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Yongbao was transferred to Jiangxi governor; Chen Yongfu to Guizhou governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Yongbao took Jiangxi and Chen Yongfu took Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 己未，撥兩淮運庫銀一百萬兩交河南備賑。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, one million taels from the Liang-Huai transport treasury were allocated to Henan for famine relief.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, one million taels from the Liang-Huai transport treasury were sent to Henan for relief.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，上秋獮木蘭。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, the Emperor conducted the autumn hunt at Mulan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, the Emperor hunted at Mulan in autumn.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，山西平陽等屬飢，給貧民兩月糧。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, because Pingyang and subordinate districts in Shanxi were famished, two months' grain was given to the poor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, two months' grain was given to the poor in famished Shanxi districts around Pingyang.

sentences.zh: 壬申，上駐蹕避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day renshen, the Emperor halted at the Mountain Resort for Avoiding Summer Heat.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, the Emperor stayed at the Summer Resort.

sentences.zh: 丙子，命梁國治為東閣大學士，兼戶部尚書，劉墉協辦大學士。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Liang Guozhi was ordered made Grand Secretary of the Eastern Pavilion, concurrently Minister of Revenue; Liu Yong, associate grand secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Liang Guozhi became Eastern Pavilion grand secretary and revenue minister; Liu Yong became associate grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 以曹文埴為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Cao Wenzhuan was made Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Wenzhuan became revenue minister.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，柘城盜匪平。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, banditry at Zhecheng was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, bandits at Zhecheng were pacified.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑江蘇銅山等十六州縣、山東陵縣等四十州縣旱災。

translations.literal: That month, drought relief was given for sixteen Jiangsu prefectures and counties including Tongshan and forty Shandong prefectures and counties including Lingxian.
translations.idiomatic: That month, drought relief went to sixteen Jiangsu districts including Tongshan and forty Shandong districts including Lingxian.

sentences.zh: 六月壬午，以漕運遲誤，薩載等下部嚴議，分別賠償。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renwu: because of delayed grain transport, Sazai and others were referred for strict deliberation and ordered to compensate by degree.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renwu day, Sazai and others faced strict inquiry and graded compensation for late grain transport.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，理藩院尚書博清阿卒。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs Boqing'a died.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Colonial Affairs Minister Boqing'a died.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以留保住為理藩院尚書。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Liubao was made minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Liubao became colonial affairs minister.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以奎林署伊犁將軍，永鐸署烏魯木齊都統。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Kuilin acted as Ili general; Yongduo acted as Urumqi commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Kuilin acted as Ili general and Yongduo as Urumqi commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，命再截留江西漕糧十萬石於安徽備賑。

translations.literal: On day yisi, an order was issued to divert a further 100,000 shi of Jiangxi canal grain, held in Anhui for relief reserves.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, another 100,000 shi of Jiangxi canal grain was held in Anhui for relief stores.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑安徽亳州等八州縣旱災。

translations.literal: That month, drought relief was given for eight Anhui prefectures and counties including Bozhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month, drought relief went to eight Anhui districts including Bozhou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己酉，調富勒渾為兩廣總督，以雅德為閩浙總督，浦霖為福建巡撫。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiyou: Fulehun was transferred to Liangguang governor-general; Yade was made Min-Zhe governor-general; Pulin, Fujian governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month, on jiyou day, Fulehun took Liangguang; Yade took Min-Zhe; Pulin took Fujian.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，調浦霖為湖南巡撫，以徐嗣曾為福建巡撫。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Pulin was transferred to Hunan governor; Xu Cizeng was made Fujian governor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Pulin took Hunan and Xu Cizeng took Fujian.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以李慶棻為貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Li Qingfen was made Guizhou governor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Li Qingfen became Guizhou governor.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，撥戶部銀一百萬兩交河南備賑。

translations.literal: On day yichou, one million taels from the Ministry of Revenue were allocated to Henan for famine relief.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, one million taels from the revenue ministry were sent to Henan for relief.

sentences.zh: 辛未，賑山西代州等六州縣水災。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, flood relief was given for six Shanxi prefectures and counties including Daizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, flood relief went to six Shanxi districts including Daizhou.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以奎林為伊犁將軍，永鐸為烏魯木齊都統。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Kuilin was made Ili general; Yongduo, Urumqi commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Kuilin became Ili general and Yongduo Urumqi commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 八月乙酉，命阿桂赴河南勘災，兼赴江南、山東查辦河運。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yiyou: Agui was ordered to Henan to inspect disaster, and also to Jiangnan and Shandong to investigate canal transport.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yiyou day, Agui was sent to inspect Henan disaster and Jiangnan and Shandong canal transport.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，上幸木蘭行圍。

translations.literal: On day guisi, the Emperor went to Mulan for the enclosure hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, the Emperor hunted at Mulan.

sentences.zh: 庚子，賑陝西朝邑縣水災。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, flood relief was given for Chaoyi County, Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, flood relief went to Chaoyi in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以伊桑阿為山西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Yisang'a was made Shanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Yisang'a became Shanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 九月己酉，命福康安赴阿克蘇安輯回眾。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiyou: Fukang'an was ordered to Aksu to pacify and settle the Muslim populace.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiyou day, Fukang'an was sent to Aksu to pacify the Muslim populace.

sentences.zh: 以慶桂為烏什參贊大臣，署陝甘總督。

translations.literal: Qinggui was made Wushi councilor, acting Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Qinggui became Wushi councilor and acted as Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.

sentences.zh: 降海祿為伊犁領隊大臣。

translations.literal: Hailu was demoted to Ili expeditionary vice commander.
translations.idiomatic: Hailu was demoted to Ili expeditionary vice commander.

sentences.zh: 命明亮以伊犁參贊大臣署烏什參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Mingliang was ordered, as Ili councilor, to act as Wushi councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Mingliang, as Ili councilor, was ordered to act as Wushi councilor.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，上駐蹕避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the Emperor halted at the Mountain Resort for Avoiding Summer Heat.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, the Emperor stayed at the Summer Resort.

sentences.zh: 戊午，調永保為陝西巡撫，何裕城為江西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Yongbao was transferred to Shaanxi governor; He Yucheng to Jiangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Yongbao took Shaanxi and He Yucheng took Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 壬申，賑江蘇長洲等五十六州縣衛旱災。

translations.literal: On day renshen, drought relief was given for fifty-six Jiangsu prefectures, counties, and guards including Changzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, drought relief went to fifty-six Jiangsu districts and guards including Changzhou.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁丑朔，召勒保、松筠回京，命佛住駐庫倫，會同蘊端多爾濟辦事。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, new moon on day dingchou: Lebao and Songyun were recalled to the capital; Fozhu was ordered stationed at Khalkha, jointly conducting affairs with Yunduoduoerji.
translations.idiomatic: At the tenth-month winter new moon, on dingchou day, Lebao and Songyun were recalled; Fozhu was posted to Khalkha with Yunduoduoerji.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，賑湖南巴陵等十州縣旱災。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, drought relief was given for ten Hunan prefectures and counties including Baling.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, drought relief went to ten Hunan districts including Baling.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，賑安徽亳州五十一州縣並鳳陽等九衛旱災。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, drought relief was given for fifty-one Anhui prefectures and counties including Bozhou and nine guards including Fengyang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, drought relief went to fifty-one Anhui districts including Bozhou and nine guards including Fengyang.

sentences.zh: 是月，免甘肅皋蘭等十二廳州縣衛本年雹水災額賦。

translations.literal: That month, this year's hail-and-flood disaster quota land tax was remitted for twelve Gansu departments, prefectures, counties, and guards including Gaolan.
translations.idiomatic: That month, this year's hail-and-flood quota taxes were remitted in twelve Gansu districts and guards including Gaolan.

sentences.zh: 賑直隸平鄉等十六州縣水旱災，河南永城等十二州縣旱災。

translations.literal: Relief was given for flood and drought disasters in sixteen Zhili prefectures and counties including Pingxiang, and for drought disasters in twelve Henan prefectures and counties including Yongcheng.
translations.idiomatic: Sixteen Zhili units including Pingxiang were relieved for flood and drought, and twelve Henan units including Yongcheng for drought.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙亥，以乾隆六十年乙卯正旦推算日食，宣諭定次年歸政。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yihai: because a solar eclipse was calculated for New Year's Day of the sixtieth year of the Qianlong reign (yimao), the Emperor proclaimed and fixed abdication for the following year.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yihai day, the Emperor announced abdication the next year after calculating an eclipse on Qianlong 60 New Year's Day.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑山東嶧縣等九州縣旱災，甘肅河州等七州縣水雹災。

translations.literal: That month, drought relief was given for nine Shandong prefectures and counties including Yixian, and flood and hail relief for seven Gansu prefectures and counties including Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Shandong units including Yixian received drought relief and Gansu units including Hezhou relief for flood and hail.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁丑，以御史富森阿條陳地丁錢糧請收本色，諭斥為斷不可行，罷之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dingchou: because Censor Fusen'a memorialized requesting that land-and-service tax grain be collected in kind, an edict rebuked this as absolutely unfeasible and he was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day in the twelfth month, Fusen'a was dismissed after proposing in-kind land-tax collection was denounced as impossible.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以明亮為烏什參贊大臣，慶桂為塔爾巴哈台參贊大臣。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Mingliang was made participating minister at Ush, and Qing Gui participating minister at Tarbaghatai.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Mingliang became Ush participating minister and Qing Gui Tarbaghatai participating minister.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，禁廣東洋商及粵海關監督貢獻。

translations.literal: On day renyin, presentation of tribute by Guangdong foreign traders and the superintendent of the Guangdong Maritime Customs was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Guangdong foreign merchants and the Canton customs superintendent were forbidden to send tribute.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑陝西朝邑等三縣水災。

translations.literal: That month, flood relief was given for three Shaanxi counties including Chaoyi.
translations.idiomatic: That month, three Shaanxi counties including Chaoyi were relieved for flood.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮來貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Korea sent tribute.
